en: Can you talk a bit about how history plays a role in this project?
cn: 您能谈一谈历史因素在这个项目中起到了什么作用吗？

en: Sure.
cn: 当然可以。

en: The project is also about the history of Europe looking at the sea and wondering when the next enemy would appear.
cn: 这个项目也关乎欧洲——它凝望大海，想知道下一个敌人何时到来——的历史。

en: In the images, you see all kinds of possible defense constructions to hold back the Romans, Germans, Vikings, and now nature as enemy number one.
cn: 在这些照片中，你能看到各式各样可能用来抵御罗马人、日耳曼人、维京人以及现在的头号敌人大自然的防御工事。

en: For example, there is the image of the bridge into the sea taken at the Normandy D-Day landing site.
cn: 比如，这张照片里就是在诺曼底登陆地拍摄的那座伸向大海的桥。

en: Also, Venice, the city eternally threatened by the sea, where every morning wooden pathways have to be set up to allow tourists to reach their hotels.
cn: 另外还有威尼斯，这座城市时时刻刻受到海水的威胁，每天早上必须搭建好木栈道才能让游客进入酒店。

en: Thank you, Mr. De Keyzer.
cn: 谢谢您，德·凯瑟尔先生。

en: It was a pleasure to have you with us today.
cn: 很高兴今天您能来和我们见面。

en: When facing a new situation, some people tend to rehearse their defeat by spending too much time anticipating the worst.
cn: 面对新环境时，有些人往往花太多时间预想最糟糕的情况，在心里预演自己的失败。

en: I remember talking with a young lawyer who was about to begin her first jury trial.
cn: 我记得曾和一位马上要开始自己首次陪审团审判的年轻律师谈话。

en: She was very nervous.
cn: 她非常紧张。

en: I asked what impression she wanted to make on the jury.
cn: 我问她想给陪审团留下什么印象。

en: She replied, "I don't want to look too inexperienced; I don't want them to suspect this is my first trial."
cn: 她回答说：“我不想自己看起来毫无经验，不想让他们觉得这是我首次参与审判。”

en: This lawyer had fallen victim to the "don't's syndrome, a form of negative goal setting.
cn: 这位律师已患上“不要做”综合征，这是一种消极的目标设定。

en: The "don't's" can be self-fulfilling because your mind responds to pictures.
cn: “不要做”可能自我应验，因为你的心思会对想象做出回应。

en: Research conducted at Stanford University shows a mental image fires the nervous system the same way as actually doing something.
cn: 斯坦福大学所做的研究表明，脑海景象刺激神经系统的方式和实际行为是一样的。

en: That means when a golfer tells himself "Don't hit the ball into the water," his mind sees the image of the ball flying into the water.
cn: 这意味着当一位高尔夫球手告诉自己“不要把球打到水里去”的时候，他内心会看到球飞入水中的画面。

en: So guess where the ball will go.
cn: 所以你猜球会打到哪儿。

en: Consequently, before going into any stressful situation, focus only on what you want to have happen.
cn: 因此，在进入紧张状态之前，应完全专注于你希望发生的事情。

en: I asked the lawyer again how she wanted to appear at her first trial, and this time she said: "I want to look professional and self-assured."
cn: 我又问这位律师她希望在自己初次审判中是什么样子，这次她说：“我想看起来既专业又自信。”

en: I told her to create a picture of what "self-assured" would look like.
cn: 我让她想象“自信”看起来是怎么样的。

en: To her, it meant moving confidently around the court room, using convincing body language and projecting her voice, so it could be heard from the judge's bench to the back door.
cn: 对她来说，那意味着在法庭上一边自信地走动，一边使用令人信服的肢体语言、同时运气发声，让自己的声音从法官席到后门都能听见。

en: She also imagined a skillful closing argument and a winning trial.
cn: 她还设想了一段巧妙的结案陈词和一场以胜利告终的审判。

en: A few weeks after this positive dress rehearsal, the young lawyer did win.
cn: 这场积极预演过后几周，这位年轻的律师确实赢了。

en: Most Americans don't eat enough fruits, vegetables or whole grains.
cn: 大多数美国人水果、蔬菜及全谷物摄入不足。

en: Research now says adding fiber to the teen diet may help lower the risk of breast cancer.
cn: 现在，研究表明增加青少年饮食里的膳食纤维可能有助于降低乳腺癌风险。

en: Conversations about the benefits of fiber are probably more common in nursing homes than high schools.
cn: 相对于高中，养老院里关于膳食纤维益处的讨论大概要更常见一些。

en: But along comes a new study that could change that.
cn: 但出现了一项可能改变这种状况新研究。

en: Kristi King, a diet specialist at Texas Children's Hospital finds it's hard to get teenager patients' attention about healthy eating but telling them that eating lots of high-fiber foods could reduce the risk of breast cancer before middle age.
cn: 德克萨斯州儿童医院的饮食专家克里斯蒂·金发现，除非告诉青少年患者摄入大量高纤维食物有助于降低中年前患乳腺癌的风险，否则很难让他们关注饮食健康。

en: That's a powerful message.
cn: 这是一条极具说服力的信息。

en: The new finding is based on a study of 44,000 women.
cn: 新发现基于一项以4.4万名女性为对象的研究。

en: They were surveyed about their diets during high school, and their eating habits were tracked for two decades.
cn: 研究调查了她们高中时期的饮食，并记录了她们（此后）二十年的饮食习惯。

en: It turns out that those who consumed the highest levels of fiber during adolescence had a lower risk of developing breast cancer, compared to the women who ate the least fiber.
cn: 研究发现相较于膳食纤维摄入最低的女性，青少年时期膳食纤维摄入最高的女性患乳腺癌的风险较低。

en: This important study demonstrates that the more fiber you eat during your high school years, the lower your risk is in developing breast cancer in later life.
cn: 这项重要的研究表明，高中时摄入的膳食纤维越多，此后患乳腺癌的风险就越低。

en: The finding points to long-standing evidence that fiber may reduce circulating female hormone levels, which could explain the reduced risk.
cn: 该发现指向了一项由来已久的理论，即膳食纤维降低体内循环的雌激素水平，这能够解释（乳腺癌）风险为何降低。

en: The bottom line here is the more fiber you eat, perhaps, a lower level of hormone in your body, and therefore, a lower lifetime risk of developing breast cancer.
cn: 原理大概是，膳食纤维摄入越多，体内激素水平可能越低，因此，一生中患乳腺癌的风险也越低。

en: High-fiber diets are also linked to a reduced risk of heart disease and diabetes.
cn: 高纤维饮食也与较低的心脏病和糖尿病风险有关。

en: That's why women are told to eat 25 grams a fiber a day - men even more.
cn: 因此建议女性每天摄入25克膳食纤维——男性甚至应摄入更多。

en: Well, my current research is really about consumer behavior.
cn: 我目前的研究实际与消费者行为有关。

en: So recently I've looked at young people's drinking and it's obviously a major concern to government at the moment.
cn: 因此，近来我观察了年轻人的饮酒行为，这无疑是政府当前的重大关切。

en: I've also looked at how older people are represented in the media.
cn: 我还观察了媒体是如何表现老年人的。

en: Again, it's of major current interest with older people becoming a much larger proportion of UK, and indeed, world society.
cn: 随着老年人渐趋占到英国乃至世界社会中更大的比重，这亦是当前的重中之重。

en: I'm also interested in how consumers operate online and how that online behavior might be different from how they operate offline when they go to the shops.
cn: 我感兴趣还有消费者如何在网上采取行动、以及这种线上行为与他们去商店时采取的线下行为会有怎样的不同。

en: Well, I think that the important thing here is to actually understand what's happening from the consumers' perspective.
cn: 我认为，这其中至关重要的是真正地从消费者角度理解正在发生的事。

en: One of the things that businesses and indeed government organizations often fail to do is to really see what is happening from the consumers' perspective.
cn: 企业、甚至政府组织往往做不到的事情之一正是真正地从消费者角度观察正发生着什么。

en: For example, in the case of young people's drinking, one of the things that I've identified is that drinking for people, say, between the ages of 18 and 24 is all about the social activity.
cn: 例如，就年轻人饮酒来说，我的其中一项发现就是“饮酒对于人们，比如对于像年龄在18岁到24岁之间的人来说，完全是一种社交活动”。

en: A lot of the government advertising has been about individual responsibility, but actually understanding that drinking is very much about the social activity and finding ways to help young people get home safely and not end up in hospital is one of the things that we've tried to present there.
cn: 政府在这方面的大量宣传都涉及个人责任，但我们想说的是，真正需要的是“理解饮酒与社交活动密切相关、设法让年轻人安全回到家而不至于进了医院”。

en: The key thing about consumer behavior is that it's very much about how consumers change.
cn: 消费者行为的关键是：它与消费者如何改变紧密相关。

en: Markets always change faster than marketing, so we have to look at what consumers are doing.
cn: 市场往往比营销变化的更快，所以我们不得不观察消费者正在做什么。

en: Currently I teach consumer behavior to undergraduates in their second year and we look at all kinds of things in consumer behavior and particularly how consumers are presented in advertising.
cn: 现在，我在给二年级本科生上消费者行为课程，我们观察消费者行为的方方面面，特别是消费者是如何呈现于广告中的。

en: So they get involved by looking at advertising and really critically assessing the consumer behavior aspects of it and getting involved, sometimes doing primary research.
cn: 因此，他们亲身参与，观察广告并真正批判性地评估其中的消费者行为、有时也参加初步研究。

en: For example, last year my students spent a week looking at their own purchasing and analysed it in detail from shopping to the relationship that they have with their retail banks and their mobile phone providers.
cn: 比如，去年我的学生花了一周时间观察自身的购买行为，从购物到他们与零售银行和移动电话供应商的关系都进行了详细分析。

en: I think they found it very useful and it also helped them identify just what kind of budgets they had too.
cn: 我想，他们觉得这十分有用，这也帮他们确定了自己的预算是什么种类。

en: The fact of the matter is that there is a whole range of interesting research out there.
cn: 事实是，未来还有大量有意思的研究。

en: And I think as the years go on, there is going to be much more for us to consider and certainly much more for students to become involved in.
cn: 我想随着岁月流逝，会有更多东西需要我们去思考，也一定会有更多研究等待学生去参与。

en: Sweden was the first European country to print and use paper money, but it may soon do away with physical currencies.
cn: 瑞典是第一个印发和使用纸币的欧洲国家，但它可能很快就会抛弃实物货币。

en: Banks can save a lot of money and avoid regulatory headaches by moving to a cash-free system, and they can also avoid bank robberies, theft, and dirty money.
cn: 银行转变为无现金系统能省很多钱，并且能避免监管难题，还能避免抢劫、盗窃和黑钱问题。

en: Claer Barrett, the editor of Financial Times Money, says the Western world is headed toward a world without physical currency.
cn: 《金融时报》“钱经”板块的主编克莱尔·巴雷特称，西方世界正朝着无实体货币的方向前进。

en: Andy Holder—the chief economist at The Bank of England—suggested that the UK move towards a government-backed digital currency.
cn: 英格兰银行首席经济学家安迪·霍尔德表示，英国在走向政府支持的数字货币（之路）。

en: But does a cashless society really make good economic sense?
cn: 但无现金社会真得能带来良好的经济效益吗？

en: The fact that cash is being drawn out of society, is less a feature of our everyday lives, and the ease of electronic payments—is this actually making us spend more money without realizing it?
cn: 现金正在被剥离出社会这一实现在我们的日常生活中越来越不足为奇了，而电子支付轻松便捷——事实上这是否让我们稍不留神就花出去了更多的钱？

en: Barrett wanted to find out if the absence of physical currency does indeed cause a person to spend more, so she decided to conduct an experiment a few months ago.
cn: 巴雷特想要弄清没有实物货币是否确实能导致一个人花更多的钱，因此，在几个月前，她决定做一个实验。

en: She decided that she was going to try to just use cash for two weeks to make all of her essential purchases and see what that would do to her spending.
cn: 她决定尝试两周内只用现金来完成所有必要的购物，以此了解这种方式对其开销的影响。

en: She found she did spend a lot less money because it is incredibly hard to predict how much cash one is going to need—she was forever drawing money out of cash points.
cn: 她发现自己的支出的确大大减少了，因为预测一个人需要用多少现金简直太困难了——所以她一直不停地去自动取款机取钱。

en: Months later, she was still finding cash stuffed in her trouser pockets and the pockets of her handbags.
cn: 几个月后，她依旧能在裤兜和手包口袋里发现塞在里面的现金。

en: During the experiment, Barrett took a train ride.
cn: 实验期间，巴雷特乘坐一趟火车。

en: On the way, there was an announcement that the restaurant car was not currently accepting credit cards.
cn: 途中，列车通知餐车目前不接受信用卡支付。

en: The train cars were filled with groans because many of the passengers were traveling without cash.
cn: 列车上一时充斥着抱怨声，因为许多乘客出门旅行都没带现金。

en: "It underlines just how much things have changed in the last generation," Barrett says.
cn: “它凸显了自上一代以来发生了多么大的变化，”巴雷特说道。

en: "My parents, when they were younger, used to budget by putting money into envelopes—they'd get paid and they'd immediately separate the cash into piles and put them in envelopes, so they knew what they had to spend week by week.
cn: “我父母年轻的时候，常常通过把钱装进信封的方式来安排开销——他们拿到工资后，就立即把现金分为几叠装进不同的信封里，这样他们就会很清楚每周必须的花销。

en: It was a very effective way for them to keep track of their spending.
cn: 对他们来说，用这种方式记录开销十分有效。

en: Nowadays, we're all on credit cards, we're doing online purchases, and money is kind of becoming a less physical and more imaginary type of thing that we can't get our hands around."
cn: 如今，我们都使用信用卡支付，我们在网上购物，金钱的实体形态有点儿日益淡化，它日益变成我们不会拿在手边的、虚幻的东西了。”

en: Why should you consider taking a course in demography in college?
cn: 为什么你应该考虑在大学里选一门种群统计学的课程？

en: You will be growing up in the generation where the baby boomers are going into retirement and dying.
cn: 你成长的时代将是“婴儿潮”一代走向退休和死亡的时代。

en: You will face problems in the aging of the population that have never been faced before.
cn: 你将面临从未有人面临过的人口老龄化的诸多问题。

en: You will hear more and more about migration between countries, and between rural areas and cities.
cn: 你将越来越多听闻国与国之间、乡村地区与城市之间的人口迁移。

en: You need to understand as a citizen and as a taxpayer and as a voter what's really behind the arguments.
cn: 作为一位公民、一位纳税人和一位选举人，你需要了解上述论断实际上意味着什么。

en: I want to tell you about the past, present and future of the human population, so let's start with a few problems.
cn: 我想告诉你人类人口的过去、现在和未来，那么让我们从几个问题开始吧。

en: Right now, a billion people are chronically hungry.
cn: 目前，十亿人正面临长期饥饿。

en: That means they wake up hungry, they are hungry all day and they go to sleep hungry.
cn: 这意味着他们在饥饿中醒来，饿着肚子过一整天，又带着饥饿入睡。

en: A billion people are living in slums, not the same billion people, but there is some overlap.
cn: 十亿人正居住在贫民窟中，这不是同一批人，但二者有一些交集。

en: Living in slums means they don't have infrastructure to take the garbage away.
cn: 居住在贫民窟意味着他们没有回收垃圾的基础设施。

en: They don't have secure water supplies to drink.
cn: 他们没有安全的饮用水源。

en: Nearly a billion people are illiterate.
cn: 近十亿人是文盲。

en: Try to imagine your life being illiterate.
cn: 试着想象一下你变成文盲的生活。

en: You can't read the labels on the bottles in the supermarket, if you can get to a supermarket.
cn: 即使你能到达超市，超市里瓶子上的标签你也看不懂。

en: Two thirds of those people who are illiterate are women and about 200 to 250 million women don't have access to birth control they want so that they can control their own fertility.
cn: 文盲群体中三分之二为女性，约2亿到2.5亿女性无法如愿获得避孕手段，因而无法自主控制生育。

en: This is not only a problem in developing countries; about half of all pregnancies globally are unintended.
cn: 这并非发展中国家独有的问题，全球约半数怀孕女性是意外怀孕。

en: So those are examples of population problems.
cn: 以上就是种群问题的若干例子。

en: Demography gives you the tools to understand and to address these problems.
cn: 种群统计学为你提供理解和解决这些问题的工具。

en: It's not only the study of human population, but the populations of non-human species, including viruses, like influenza, the bacteria in your gut, plants that you eat, animals that you enjoy or that provide you with meat.
cn: 它不仅研究人口，还研究非人类物种种群，包括导致感冒等疾病的病毒、肠道细菌、你食用的作物、你享用的或者为你提供肉食的动物。

en: Demography also includes the study of non-living objects like light bulbs and taxi cabs and buildings because these are also populations.
cn: 种群统计学还涉及对非生物体的研究，如灯泡、出租车和建筑物等，因为它们也是统计总体。

en: It studies these populations in the past, present and future, using quantitative data and mathematical models as tools of analysis.
cn: 这门学科使用定量数据和数学模型的分析工具研究这些统计总体的过去、现在和未来。

en: I see demography as a central subject related to economics.
cn: 我将种群统计学视为与经济学相关的一门核心学科。

en: It is the means to intervene more wisely and more effectively in the real world to improve the wellbeing not only of yourself, important as that may be, but of people around you and of other species with whom we share the planet.
cn: 它是一种更加睿智且有效地干预现实世界的手段，可以提升自身福祉。虽然这点很重要，但更重要的是它还能提升你周围的人以及与人类共享地球的其他物种的福祉。

en: Mr. Ishiguro, have you ever found one of your books at a secondhand bookstore?
cn: 石黑（一雄）先生，您在二手书店见过您的书吗？

en: Yes.
cn: 见过。

en: That kind of thing is difficult.
cn: 这种事令人纠结。

en: If they've got my book there, I think, "Well, this is an insult! Somebody didn't want to keep my book!"
cn: 如果有人把我的书放在那儿，我会想，“这是种耻辱！有人不想保留我的书！”

en: But if it's not there, I feel it's an insult too.
cn: 但是如果那儿没有我的书，我也会觉得耻辱。

en: I think, "Why aren't people exchanging my book? Why isn't it in this store?"
cn: 我会想，“人们怎么不交换我的书呢？为什么这家店里没有我的书呢？”

en: Does being a writer require a thick skin?
cn: 当作家需要厚脸皮吗？

en: Yes, for example, my wife can be very harsh.
cn: 需要，比如，我妻子会相当苛刻。

en: I began working on my latest book, The Buried Giant, in 2004 but I stopped after I showed my wife a little section.
cn: 我2004年开始写新书《被掩埋的巨人》，但给我妻子看过一小部分后我就停笔了。

en: She thought it was rubbish.
cn: 她认为写的是垃圾。

en: Even after you won a Booker Prize?
cn: 即使在您获得布克奖之后？

en: She's not intimidated at all and she criticizes me in exactly the same way she did when I was first unpublished and I was starting.
cn: 她一点都不为其所动，还和我刚开始未发表过文章时一样批评我。

en: But you would never compromise on your vision.
cn: 但是您不会在自己的构思上妥协。

en: No, I wouldn't ever compromise on the essential, the ideas or the themes.
cn: 是的，我从不会在本质的内容、思想或主题上让步。

en: This isn't really what my wife is trying to criticize me about.
cn: 这不是我妻子想要批评的点。

en: It's always about execution.
cn: 她总是批评创作手法。

en: So why did you put your book, The Buried Giant, aside for so long?
cn: 那您为什么把《被掩埋的巨人》这本书搁置那么久呢？

en: Apparently you started working on it over 10 years ago.
cn: 显然您十多年以前就开始写它了。

en: I've often stopped writing a book and left it for a few years.
cn: 我经常停写一本书，把它放上几年。

en: And by the time I come back to it, it may have changed.
cn: 当我再回来写它的时候，它可能就变了。

en: Usually my imagination has moved on and I can think of different contexts or a different way to do it.
cn: 通常我的想象发生了变化，我会想出不同的故事背景，或不同的写作方式。

en: What does it feel like when you finally finish a book?
cn: 当您终于完成一本书时是什么感觉呢？

en: It's funny you ask that because I never have this moment when I feel, "Ah, I've finished!"
cn: 您这么问很有趣，因为我从来没有过“啊，终于完成了！”这种感觉。

en: I watch footballers at the end of the match, you know, the whistle goes and they've won or lost.
cn: 要知道，我会在足球比赛结束时观察球员，终场哨声一响，胜败已定。

en: Until then they've been giving everything they have and at that moment they know it's over.
cn: 在此之前，他们竭尽全力（踢球），而在那一刻他们知道比赛结束了。

en: It's funny for an author.
cn: （但）这对于作家就很难说了。

en: There's never a finishing whistle.
cn: （因为对作家来说）从来都没有终场哨。

en: According to a study of Race & Equity in Education, black athletes are dropping out of college across the country at alarming rates.
cn: 根据《教育中的种族与平等》研究，全国各地黑人运动员正在以惊人的速度从大学退学。

en: With us to talk about the findings in the study is Washington Post columnist Kevin Blackstone.
cn: 和我们一起来讨论这项研究结果的是《华盛顿邮报》的专栏记者凯文·布莱克斯通。

en: Good morning!
cn: 早上好！

en: Good morning.
cn: 早上好。

en: How are you?
cn: 你好吗？

en: Fine, thank you.
cn: 我很好，谢谢你。

en: What is new that you found in this study?
cn: 您在这项研究中有什么新的发现？

en: Well, this is Shaun Harper's study.
cn: 嗯，这是肖恩·哈珀的研究。

en: And he points out that on major college campuses across the country, black males make up less than 3 percent of undergraduate enrollments.
cn: 他指出在全国主要的大学校园里，黑人男性的大学入学率不到3%。

en: Yet, when you look at their numbers or percentages on the revenue-generating sports teams of football and basketball, they make up well into 50-60 percent of those teams.
cn: 可你看看创收型美式橄榄球队和篮球队中他们的数量或占比，足足占到那些队伍人数的五到六成还多。

en: So the idea is that they are really there to be part of the revenue-generating working class of athletes on campus and not necessarily there to be part of the educating class as most students in other groups are.
cn: 也就是说，他们上大学实际上成为校园中能够创收的工薪阶层——大学运动员的一部分，而未必像其他族群的大多数学生那样成为教育阶层的一部分。

en: Compared with other groups, I think the numbers in this group at those 65 schools are something like just barely more than half of the black male athletes graduate at all.
cn: 与其他族群相比，我认为这个族群在那65所学校中，居然大约只有勉强超过一半的黑人男性运动员从大学毕业。

en: Exactly.
cn: 确实如此。

en: And what's really bad about this is these athletes are supposedly promised at least one thing as reward for all their blood and sweat.
cn: 关于这一点真正糟糕的是这些运动员本应该被允诺至少一件事情作为对于他们血汗的回报。

en: And that is a college degree, which can be a transformative tool in our society when you talk about upward mobility.
cn: 那就是大学学位，当你考虑向上流动时，大学学位在我们的社会中可以成为一种转换工具。

en: And that's really the troubling part about this.
cn: 而这真的是这件事令人担忧的地方。

en: Well, this has been talked about so much, really, in recent years.
cn: 嗯，这种情况最近几年已经被讨论得很多了。

en: Why hasn't changed?
cn: 为什么还没有改变？

en: Well, I think one of the reasons it hasn't changed is because there is really no economic pressure to change this.
cn: 嗯，我认为情况没有改变的原因之一是确实没有经济压力来改变这一局面。

en: All of the incentive is really on winning and not losing on the field or on the court.
cn: 所有的动机实际上都在于在赛场上赢得胜利而不是输掉比赛。

en: Coaches do not necessarily have the incentive to graduate players.
cn: 教练不一定会有动力让运动员毕业。

en: America's holiday shopping season starts on Black Friday, the day after Thanksgiving.
cn: 美国的节假日购物季从黑色星期五，也就是感恩节后的第一天开始。

en: It is the busiest shopping day of the year.
cn: 这是一年中最繁忙的购物日。

en: Retailers make the most money this time of year, about 20 to 30 percent of annual revenue.
cn: 每年这个时候，零售商的收入最多，大约占年收入的20%至30%。

en: About 136 million people will shop during the Thanksgiving Holiday weekend.
cn: 感恩节周末期间，约有1.36亿人购物。

en: More and more will shop online.
cn: 越来越多的人选择上网购物。

en: In an era of instant information, shoppers can use their mobile phones to find deals.
cn: 在即时信息时代，购物者可以使用手机来购物。

en: About 183.8 million people will shop on Cyber Monday, the first Monday after Thanksgiving.
cn: 大约1.838亿人会在网络星期一，也就是感恩节后的第一个星期一购物。

en: More than half of all holiday purchases will be made online.
cn: 半数以上的假期购物会在网上进行。

en: One in five Americans will use a tablet or smartphone.
cn: 五分之一美国人将使用平板电脑或智能手机（进行购物）。

en: Online spending on Black Friday will rise 15 percent to hit $2.7 billion this year.
cn: 今年，黑色星期五的网上消费将增长15%，达到27亿美元。

en: Cyber Monday spending will increase 12 percent to $3 billion.
cn: 网络星期一的消费将增加12%，达到30亿美元。

en: For many, shopping online was a more comfortable alternative than crowded malls.
cn: 对许多人来说，比起拥挤的购物中心，网购是一个“更加舒心的选择”。

en: The shift to online shopping has had a big impact on traditional shopping malls.
cn: 人们转向网购的行为对传统购物中心产生了很大的影响。

en: Since 2010, more than 24 shopping malls have closed and an additional 60 are struggling.
cn: 自2010年以来，已有超过24家购物中心关闭，另有60家商场陷入困境。

en: However, Fortune says the weakest of the malls have closed.
cn: 但《财富》杂志称，倒闭的都是实力最弱的购物中心。

en: The sector is thriving again.
cn: 这一行业正再次繁荣起来。

en: The International Council of Shopping Centers said 94.2 percent of malls were full, or occupied with shops by the end of 2014.
cn: 国际购物中心协会表示，截至2014年底，94.2%的购物中心已经被店铺占满。

en: That is the highest level in 27 years.
cn: 这是27年来的最高水平。

en: Economist Gus Faucher said lower unemployment and rising wages could give Americans more money to spend.
cn: 经济学家格斯·福彻称，失业率降低和工资上涨可使美国人有更多的钱用于消费。

en: The average American consumer will spend about $805 on gifts.
cn: 美国消费者送礼平均花费约为805美元。

en: That's about $630.5 billion between November and December—an increase of 3.7 percent from last year.
cn: 十一至十二月间，礼物消费总额约为6305亿美元，较去年增加3.7%。

en: For years, many of us have relied on antibiotic use to treat various infections.
cn: 多年来，我们很多人都依赖抗生素来治疗各种感染。

en: And the reality is that antibiotics have been responsible for saving millions of lives since penicillin, one of the earliest antibiotics, was first used on a clinical basis 70 years ago.
cn: 事实上，自青霉素——最早的抗生素之一——在70年前首次用于临床以来，抗生素已经挽救了数百万人的生命。

en: However, today is a new era in which taking antibiotics can cause some very dangerous and potentially life-threatening situations.
cn: 然而，在今天这样一个新时代，服用抗生素会导致一些非常危险的情况，还有可能危及生命。

en: In fact, you may have heard about the new "superbugs", which are antibiotic-resistant bacteria that have developed as a result of overprescribed antibiotics.
cn: 事实上，你可能已经听说过一种新的“超级细菌”，它是由于过度使用抗生素而产生的耐抗生素细菌。

en: In the past, health experts warned us that the day would come in which it would become very difficult to provide medical care for even common problems, such as lung infection or severe sore throat.
cn: 过去，健康专家曾经警告过我们，有朝一日，即使是治疗肺部感染、重度咽痛等常见疾病也将变得非常困难。

en: And, apparently, that day has come because seemingly routine operations such as knee replacements are now much more hazardous due to the looming threat of these infections.
cn: 显然，这一天已经来临，因为膝关节置换这样看似常规的手术现在也因这些潜在的感染而变得更加危险。

en: The problem has grown into such epidemic proportions that this severe strain of resistant bacteria is being blamed for nearly 700,000 deaths each year throughout the world, and, unfortunately, health experts worry that the number will rise to 10 million or more on a yearly basis by 2050.
cn: 这个问题已达到流行病程度以至于这种威胁巨大的抗药性细菌每年导致全球近70万人死亡，不幸的是，健康专家担心，到2050年，这一数字将上升到每年1000万人甚至更多。

en: With such a large life-threatening epidemic, it is sad to say that only 1.2 percent of budgetary money for the National Institutes of Health is currently being spent on research to tackle this problem.
cn: 令人悲哀的是，面对如此大规模的致命流行病，目前国立卫生研究院的预算资金中只有1.2%用于解决这一问题的研究。

en: This is a far cry from the funds necessary for a problem of such magnitude.
cn: 对于这样一个严峻的问题，这点资金无异于杯水车薪。

en: This is the reason you are here in a university.
cn: 这就是你们来上大学的原因。

en: You are here to be educated.
cn: 你们来这儿是为了接受教育。

en: You are here to understand thinking better and to think better yourself.
cn: 你们来这儿是为了更好地理解“思考”，为了更好地进行独立思考。

en: It's not a chance you're going to have throughout your lifetime.
cn: 这种机会你终生都不会有。

en: For the next few years, you have a chance to focus on thinking.
cn: 在接下来的几年里，你们就有机会专注于“思考”。

en: I think about some of the students who took advantage of their opportunities in a university.
cn: 我想起一些在大学里把握住机会的学生。

en: One of the stories I always like to tell is of a freshman seminar that I had a chance to teach at Harvard when I was president of the university.
cn: 我总喜欢讲的一个故事是关于一门新生研讨课，当时我作为哈佛大学的校长有幸教授了这门课。

en: I taught a seminar on globalization and I assigned a reading that I had written about global capital flows.
cn: 我讲了一堂有关全球化的研讨课并布置了一项阅读作业，内容是我之前的有关全球资本流动的文章。

en: And as I did each week, I asked one of the students to introduce the readings.
cn: 就像每周例行的那样，我让一名学生介绍阅读的内容。

en: And this young man, in October of his freshman year, said something like the following.
cn: 当时是十月份，这名年轻人刚上大一，他大概是这么回答的。

en: "The reading by President Summers on the flow of capital across countries, it was kind of interesting, but the data did not come close to supporting the conclusions."
cn: “萨莫斯校长写的这篇关于资本跨国流动的文章有些意思，但其数据不能支持其结论。”

en: And I thought to myself, "What a fantastic thing this was! How could somebody who had been there for five weeks tell the person who had the title 'President' that he didn't really know what he was talking about?"
cn: 我心想：“这真是了不得啊！一个刚来五个星期的人怎么能对有‘校长’头衔的人说他其实并不知道自己在说些什么？”

en: And it was a special moment.
cn: 那是个特别的时刻。

en: Now, I don't want to be misunderstood.
cn: 好吧，我不想让人误会。

en: I explained to my student that I actually thought he was rather more confused than I was and I argued back, but what was really important about that was the universities stand out as places that really are about the authority of ideas.
cn: 我当时向我的学生解释道，其实我认为他比我更糊涂，然后我反驳了他。不过在这件事上真正重要的是，大学与众不同在于它确实是“思想的权威”之地。

en: You see it in faculty members who are pleased when their students make a discovery that undermines a cherished theory that they had put forward.
cn: 从那些因学生的发现动摇了他们之前提出的宝贵理论而感到高兴的教师身上，你就能看到这一点。

en: I think of another student I had who came to me one morning, one evening actually, walked into my office and said that I had written a pretty good paper, but that it had five important mistakes and that he wanted a job.
cn: 我还记得另一名我教的学生。某天，其实是某个晚上，他走进我的办公室说我写了一篇相当不错的论文，但里面有五处重大的错误，他还跟我说他想要一份工作。

en: You could debate whether they actually were mistakes, but you couldn't debate that young man's hunger to learn.
cn: 那些错误是否真的错有待商榷，但无可争辩的是这位年轻人对学习的渴望。

en: You could not debate that that young man was someone who wanted to make a difference in economics and he is today a professor of economics.
cn: 无可争辩的是他想要在经济学领域干出一番事业，而现在他成了一位经济学教授。

en: And his works are more cited as an economist than any other economist in the world.
cn: 作为经济学家，他的作品被引用的次数比世界上其他任何经济学家都要多。

en: Psychological research shows we consistently underestimate our mental powers.
cn: 心理学研究显示，我们一贯低估了我们的脑力。

en: If you think this does not apply to you, then here is a simple test to show you are wrong.
cn: 如果你认为这对你并不适用，那么这儿有个简单的测试可以证明你错了。

en: Write down the names of all the American states you can remember.
cn: 写下你能记得的所有美国州名。

en: Put the list away and then set yourself the same task a week later.
cn: 把这个列表拿走，一周后为你自己设置同样的任务。

en: Provided you have not cheated by consulting an atlas, you will notice something rather surprising.
cn: 假设你没有通过查阅地图来作弊，你会察觉一些相当令人惊讶的东西。

en: The two lists will contain roughly the same number of states, but they will not be identical.
cn: 两个列表会包含几乎同样数量的州，但是它们不会是一模一样的。

en: Some names will have slipped away, but others will have replaced them.
cn: 一些州名会被遗忘，但另一些会取而代之。

en: This suggests that somewhere in your mind you may well have a record of virtually every state.
cn: 这表明，在你大脑中某些地方，你很可能拥有几乎囊括每个州的记录。

en: So it is not really your memory letting you down; just your ability to retrieve information from it.
cn: 所以，令你失望的并非你的记忆，只是你从中检索信息的能力。

en: We would remember a lot more if we had more confidence in our memories and knew how to use them properly.
cn: 如果我们对自己的记忆更有信心而且懂得如何正确使用它们，我们会记住多得多的东西。

en: One useful tip is that things are more likely to be remembered if you are in exactly the same state and place as you were when you learned them.
cn: 一个有用的窍门是：如果你恰好处于学到某些东西时的状态和地点，就更可能记住它们。

en: So if you are a student who always reviews over black coffee, perhaps it would be sensible to prime yourself with a cup before the exam.
cn: 因此，假如你是一名常常喝着黑咖啡复习功课的学生，可能考试前为你自己准备一杯咖啡就是明智的。

en: If possible, you should also try to learn information in the room where it is going to be tested.
cn: 如果可能，你还应该在将会进行考试的房间里学习。

en: When you learn is also important.
cn: 何时学习也很重要。

en: Lots of people swear they can absorb new information more efficiently at some time of the day than at others.
cn: 很多人肯定地说，比之其他时候，他们在一天中的某些时候能更高效地吸收新信息。

en: Research shows this is not just imagination.
cn: 研究显示，这并非仅是妄想。

en: There is a biological rhythm for learning, though it affects different people in different ways.
cn: 学习有生物节律，尽管它对不同的人有着不同的影响方式。

en: For most of us, the best plan is to take in new information in the morning and then try to consolidate it into memory during the afternoon.
cn: 对于我们中的大多数人而言，最好的方法是，在早晨吸收新信息，然后在下午试着将其固化于记忆之中。

en: But this does not apply to everyone, so it is essential to establish your own rhythm.
cn: 但这并不适用于每一个人，所以确立你自己的节律很必要。

en: You can do this by learning a set number of lines of poetry at different times of the day and seeing when most lines stick.
cn: 你可以通过以下方式确立节律：在一天中的不同时间学习固定数量的几行诗，看何时能记住大多数诗行。

en: When you have done this, try to organize your life so that the time set aside for learning coincides with the time when your memory is at its best.
cn: 这么做了之后，试着安排你的生活，把为学习留出的时间和记忆力最佳时间重合起来。

en: Avoid learning marathons—they do not make the best use of your mind.
cn: 不要“学习马拉松”—它们无法充分利用你的大脑。

en: Take plenty of breaks, because they offer a double bonus: the time off gives your mind a chance to do some preliminary consolidation and it also gives a memory boost to the learning.
cn: 要多多休息，因为它们会带来双重收获：休息时间给予大脑初步巩固之机，同时也会强化你学习时的记忆力。

en: Hello, today I'm going to talk about poverty.
cn: 大家好！今天我要谈一谈关于贫困的话题。

en: Poverty has become a critical issue in today's world.
cn: 贫困在当今世界已经成为一个严峻的问题。

en: It concerns not only us sociologists, but also economists, politicians and business people.
cn: 它不仅是我们社会学家关切的事，也为经济学家、政治家以及商业人士所关注。

en: Poverty has been understood in many different ways.
cn: 迄今为止，人们理解贫困的方式各不相同。

en: One useful way is to distinguish between three degrees of poverty: extreme poverty, moderate poverty, and relative poverty.
cn: 其中一种有用的方式是区分三种程度的贫困：极端贫困、中等贫困以及相对贫困。

en: The first type of poverty is extreme poverty; it's also called absolute poverty.
cn: 第一种类型的贫困是极端贫困；它也被称作绝对贫困。

en: In extreme poverty, households cannot meet basic needs for survival.
cn: 极端贫困下，家庭不能满足基本的生存需要。

en: People are chronically hungry.
cn: 人们长期处于饥饿状态。

en: They are unable to access safe drinking water, let alone health care.
cn: 他们不能获得安全饮用水，更别说医疗保健了。

en: They cannot afford education for their children.
cn: 他们也承担不起孩子的教育。

en: In short, people who live in extreme poverty do not have even the minimum resources to support themselves and their families.
cn: 简而言之，生存在极端贫困中的人们甚至没有养活他们自己和他们家庭的最低限度资源。

en: Where does extreme poverty occur?
cn: 哪里会发生极端贫困情况呢？

en: Well, you can find it only in developing countries.
cn: 只有在发展中国家才看得到。

en: Well, what about moderate poverty?
cn: 那中度贫困是什么情况呢？

en: Unlike extreme poverty, moderate poverty generally refers to conditions of life in which basic needs are met but barely.
cn: 与极端贫困不同，中度贫困一般指能勉强满足基本需求的生活状况。

en: People living in moderate poverty have the resources to keep themselves alive, but only at a very basic level.
cn: 中度贫困的人们拥有让自己存活下来的资源，但仅仅是在一个很基本的水平。

en: For example, they may have access to drinking water, but not clean, safe drinking water.
cn: 比如说，他们也许能喝到饮用水，但喝不到干净、安全的饮用水。

en: They may have a home to shelter themselves, but it does not have power supply, a telephone or plumbing.
cn: 他们可能有一个能庇护自己的家，但没有供电电源，电话或者是管道系统。

en: The third kind of poverty is relative poverty.
cn: 第三种贫困是相对贫困。

en: Relative poverty is generally considered to be a household income level, which is below a given proportion of average family income.
cn: 相对贫困一般被认为是低于特定比例平均家庭收入的家庭收入水平。

en: The relatively poor live in high-income countries, but they do not have a high income themselves.
cn: 相对贫困的人生活在高收入国家，但是他们的收入却不高。

en: The method of calculating the poverty line is different from country to country, but we can say that basically a family living in relative poverty has less than a percentage of the average family income.
cn: 每个国家计算贫困线的方法各不相同，但是我们可以说，相对贫困的家庭收入基本上低于平均家庭收入的一定比例。

en: For example, in the United States, a family can be considered poor if their income is less than 50% of the national average family income.
cn: 比如说，在美国，如果一个家庭的收入少于全国平均家庭收入的50%，这个家庭就可以被认定为贫困。

en: They can meet their basic needs, but they lack access to cultural guts, entertainment and recreation.
cn: 他们能够满足基本需求，但是无法获得文化知识、娱乐和消遣。

en: They also do not have access to quality health care, or other prerequisites for upward social mobility.
cn: 他们也不能获得优质的医疗保健，或者其他向上层社会流动的先决条件。

en: Well, I have briefly explained to you how poverty can be distinguished as extreme poverty, moderate poverty and relative poverty.
cn: 好了，我已经向你们简要解释了如何区分极端贫困、中等贫困和相对贫困。

en: We should keep these distinctions in mind when we research people's living conditions, either in the developing or the developed world.
cn: 在调查发展中或发达国家人们的生活条件时，我们都应记住这些区别。

en: And now, for the lighter side of the news, Europe is setting an example for the rest of the world when it comes to food waste.
cn: 现在来看这条新闻较为积极的一面，欧洲在解决食物浪费问题上正为世界其他地区树立榜样。

en: That's right, John.
cn: 是的，约翰。

en: This week, the Italian government passed legislation that aims to dramatically reduce the amount of food waste in the country.
cn: 本周，意大利政府颁布了旨在大力减少该国食物浪费量的立法。

en: New laws have been put into place that will make it easier for farms and supermarkets to donate unsold foods to those who are in need.
cn: 新法律已付诸实施，这将使农场和超市更容易将未售出的食品捐赠给有需要的人。

en: Yes, in an addition to this, businesses will now be rewarded for successful efforts to cut food waste.
cn: 是的，除此之外，现在能成功减少食物浪费的企业会获得奖励。

en: Italy is not the only country to focus on reducing food waste.
cn: 意大利不是唯一专注于减少食物浪费的国家。

en: Just earlier this year, the European parliament voted in favor of legislation that would stop grocery giants from unfair trading practices that result in overproduction, thus creating waste.
cn: 今年早些时候，欧盟议会投票赞成立法，禁止杂货商巨头进行会导致生产过剩、从而造成浪费的不公平贸易。

en: In France, the government has banned supermarkets from throwing away edible foods and imposed harsh penalties on businesses that fail to comply with the regulations.
cn: 在法国，政府禁止超市把可食用的食物扔掉，并对不遵守规定的企业施加严厉的惩罚。

en: While there is still much progress to be made, other countries could learn a thing or two from the example set by France and Italy.
cn: 虽然还有很多工作要做，但其他国家可以从法国和意大利树立的榜样中学到一些东西。

en: In the United States, up to 40% of all food goes uneaten.
cn: 在美国，高达40%的食物都没有被食用。

en: Despite the fact that one in seven American households lacks regular access to good food, one major cause of this problem is the confusion over food expiration labels, which are currently not regulated by the government.
cn: 尽管每个美国家庭中就有一个家庭不能稳定地获得优质食物，但造成这个问题的一个主要原因是食品过期标签的混乱状态，目前这些标签尚未受到政府的管制。

en: All this could change soon.
cn: 这一切可能即将改变。

en: This wave of new laws in Europe will definitely put more pressure on law makers to reduce food waste here.
cn: 欧洲这一新立法浪潮肯定会对（美国）这边的法律制定者施加更大的压力，以减少食物浪费。

en: We turn now to a spokesperson from Harvard University's Food Law and Policy Clinic for more on the story.
cn: 我们现在转向哈佛大学食品法律和政策科室的发言人，了解更多关于这条新闻的信息。

en: And now, let's welcome professor Edward Baker to speak to us.
cn: 现在，让我们欢迎爱德华·贝克教授为我们发言。

en: Thank you for calling Saks Fifth Avenue Department Store.
cn: 感谢您致电萨克斯第五大道百货商店。

en: How can I be of assistance to you today?
cn: 有什么我能帮您的吗？

en: Hello, I was in your store this past weekend and bought a few items.
cn: 您好，上周末我在你们店里买了几样东西。

en: Yesterday, my friend told me that the annual anniversary sales had begun.
cn: 昨天，我的朋友告诉我，周年庆甩卖已经开始了。

en: It turned out that she bought the same sweater as I did, but for a much lower price.
cn: 结果呢，她和我买了一样的外套，但价格却低了很多。

en: Yes.
cn: 是的。

en: Our anniversary sales started on Monday.
cn: 我们的周年庆甩卖是周一开始的。

en: We do offer price adjustments within 7 days of purchase to ensure our customers' satisfaction.
cn: 为保证让顾客满意，我们提供购物七日内的差价调整。

en: You said you did the purchase here this past weekend?
cn: 您说您在上周末买了那件外套？

en: Yes.
cn: 是的。

en: I was shopping in your store last Sunday afternoon.
cn: 我上周日下午在你们店里购物。

en: That would definitely fall within the price adjustment window.
cn: 那肯定是处于价格调整窗口之内。

en: Do you have an account with us?
cn: 您有我们的账户吗？

en: We can credit your account directly with the difference if you wish.
cn: 如果您愿意的话，我们可以直接把差额存入您的账户。

en: Otherwise, we can send a gift card by mail if you prefer.
cn: 不然，如果您愿意的话，我们可以寄给您一份礼品卡。

en: Crediting my account would be wonderful.
cn: 存入我的账户就很好。

en: Thank you.
cn: 谢谢。

en: Now that you mention there is a sale going on, I do remember a dress I quite liked when I was in the shop on Sunday.
cn: 既然您提到了甩卖还在进行，我记得上周日我在店里的时候有一条我非常喜欢的裙子。

en: Is it on offer as well?
cn: 那条裙子也参加活动吗？

en: Yes, ma'am.
cn: 参加，女士。

en: All the new arrivals are fifteen to twenty percent off.
cn: 所有新品都是八五折到八折。

en: In addition to the sale, we are running a promotion for complimentary tailoring if you need it.
cn: 除了甩卖，我们还有为有需要的顾客提供的免费裁剪促销活动。

en: That's good news.
cn: 这个消息太好了。

en: The dress really caught my eye but I did have some concerns about the length.
cn: 那条裙子确实吸引了我，但是我还有些担心它的长度。

en: How long will the alterations take?
cn: 裁剪需要多久呢？

en: Our tailoring department guarantees alterations to be completed within 5 working days.
cn: 我们的裁缝部保证在五个工作日内完成。

en: If you'd like, I can set one aside for you.
cn: 如果您想要，我可以为您留一件。

en: If you are able to come this afternoon, you can give your name to the sales manager and they will be able to assist you.
cn: 如果您今天下午能来，可以向销售经理报上名字，然后他们就会为您提供帮助。

en: Barbie dolls have a particular look to them.
cn: 芭比娃娃有自己特有的外形。

en: They're thin, tall, long-legged ... and virtually unlike any real human being.
cn: 她们瘦、高、腿长……且实际上不像任何真人。

en: Although over the years Barbie has had more than 180 different careers — including football coach, sign language teacher, ambassador, president and astronaut — her body shape hasn't changed much.
cn: 虽然多年来芭比娃娃已有超过180种不同职业——包括足球教练、手语老师、大使、总统和宇航员，但她的体型却没有太大改变。

en: Last year Mattel, the company that makes Barbie dolls, added some Barbies to its line that have different skin tones and hair textures.
cn: 去年，芭比娃娃制造商美泰在其产品中增加了一些有不同肤色及发质的芭比。

en: There are now Barbies with one of seven skin tones, 22 eye colours and 24 hair styles to choose from.
cn: 现在的芭比可以从7种肤色、22种眼睛颜色和24种发型中选择。

en: Last year Mattel also gave Barbie a flat foot, rather than forcing her to be "in heels" all the time like the original Barbie is.
cn: 去年，美泰还给芭比穿上了平底鞋，而不是强迫她像最初的芭比那样一直“穿高跟鞋”。

en: Now they are introducing new Barbies with three slightly different body shapes, while the original, tall and thin Barbies will continue to be sold.
cn: 现在他们正在推出三种体型略有不同的新芭比，同时，原先又高又瘦的芭比也将继续售卖。

en: In a statement on its website, the company says it wants Barbies to look more like real people, and to give "girls everywhere... infinitely more ways to spark their imagination and play out their stories."
cn: 在其网站上的一份声明中，这家公司称他们希望芭比娃娃看起来更像真人，并给“世界各地的女孩无限多的方式来激发她们的想象力，上演她们的故事”。

en: Although many people say the new Barbies are a step in the right direction, some people say they don't go far enough.
cn: 虽然很多人说新的芭比娃娃朝着正确的方向迈了一步，但有些人说她们走得还不够远。

en: They say that the new body shapes could be even more different from the original, tall, thin Barbies.
cn: 他们称，这些新体型可以与原始的高瘦版芭比更为不同。

en: Sales of Barbie dolls have been falling every year since 2012, according to CBC News.
cn: CBC新闻称，芭比娃娃的销量“自2012年起每年”都在下跌。

en: The toys aren't in stores yet but they will be sold online at the Barbie website, starting this week, for $9.99.
cn: 这些玩具还没有进店（销售），但从本周开始将在芭比网站开卖，售价9.99美元。

en: The earliest printed book we know today appeared in China in the year 868, and metal type was in use in Korea at the beginning of the fifteenth century, but it was in Germany around the year 1450 that a printing press using movable metal type was invented.
cn: 我们现知最早的印本书籍出现于868年的中国，15世纪初朝鲜已经使用金属活字，但直到1450年前后，德国才发明了金属活字印刷机。

en: Capitalism turned printing from an invention into an industry.
cn: 资本主义将印刷由一项发明变为一个产业。

en: Right from the start, book printing and publishing were organized on capitalist lines.
cn: 从一开始，书籍印刷和出版就是在资本主义生产线上组织完成的。

en: The biggest sixteenth-century printer, Plantin of Antwerp, had twenty-four printing presses and employed more than a hundred workers.
cn: 16世纪最大的印刷商，位于比利时安特卫普的普朗坦，拥有24台印刷机，雇佣工人超过100人。

en: Only a small fraction of the population was literate, but the production of books grew at an extraordinary speed.
cn: （那时）只有一小部分人识字，但书籍生产以极快的速度增长着。

en: By 1500 some twenty million volumes had already been printed.
cn: 到1500年，大约2000万卷书籍业已出版。

en: The immediate effect of printing was to increase the circulation of works that were already popular in a handwritten form, while less popular works went out of circulation.
cn: 印刷的直接作用是增强了已经广受欢迎的手抄本作品的流通，而不那么受欢迎的（手抄本）作品则停止了流通。

en: Publishers were interested only in books that would sell fairly quickly in sufficient numbers to cover the costs of production and make a profit.
cn: 出版商只对那些“能迅速大量出售、以抵消出书成本并带来收益”的图书感兴趣。

en: Thus, while printing enormously increased access to books by making cheap, high-volume production possible, it also reduced choice.
cn: 因此，虽然印刷使得价廉量大的生产变为可能，从而大大增加了书籍的可及性，但它也减少了选择。

en: The great cultural impact of printing was that it facilitated the growth of national languages.
cn: 印刷伟大的文化影响在于它促进了民族语言的发展。

en: Most early books were printed in Latin, but the market for Latin was limited, and in its pursuit of larger markets the book trade soon produced translations into the national languages emerging at the time.
cn: 大多数早期书籍是拉丁文印本，但拉丁文的市场有限。出于对更大市场的追求，书籍行业迅速发行了当时兴起的民族语言的翻译版本。

en: Printing indeed played a key role in standardizing and stabilizing these languages by fixing them in print, and producing dictionaries and grammar books.
cn: 实际上，通过以书面形式固定这些语言，发行字典和语法书等，印刷在统一和巩固这些语言方面发挥了至关重要的作用。

en: You dream about being a movie star.
cn: 你梦想成为电影明星。

en: You'll live in a big house in Hollywood, go to the Oscars every year—and win!
cn: 你将住在好莱坞的豪宅里，每年参加奥斯卡颁奖典礼——并赢取奖项！

en: You'll be rich and famous.
cn: 你将有钱又有名。

en: Wait a minute, you also hate having your photo taken, and you're very shy, so how could you ever become a movie star?
cn: 等等，（可）你又非常不喜欢拍照，而且还很害羞，那么你怎么可能会成为电影明星？

en: Choosing the right career can be hard.
cn: 选择合适的职业可能很难。

en: Many people graduate from school or college not knowing what to do with their lives, and get a job without really thinking about it.
cn: 许多人从学校或大学毕业后，并不知道要如何度过自己的一生，并未认真考虑就找了份工作。

en: For some, things work out fine, but others often find themselves stuck in a job they hate.
cn: 对于一些人来说，一切都还不错，但另一些人却通常发现自己被困在了讨厌的工作中。

en: Your working life lasts an average of forty years, so it's important to find a job you like and feel enthusiastic about.
cn: 你的工作生涯平均长达40年，因此找个你喜欢的、并且能热情投入的工作很重要。

en: Luckily, there are many ways you can get help to do this.
cn: 幸运的是，有不少方法能帮你实现这点。

en: The Australian website, www.careersonline.com, compares choosing a career with going to the movies.
cn: 澳大利亚网站www.careersonline.com就将选择职业比作去看电影。

en: Before you see a movie, you find out what films are showing.
cn: 在看电影之前，你要弄清楚什么电影正在上映。

en: The site suggests you should do the same with your career find out what jobs are available and what your options are.
cn: 这个网站建议你在找工作时也这么做——弄清楚哪些工作有空缺，你的选择有哪些。

en: Next, decide which movie you like best.
cn: 其次，判断哪部电影你最喜欢。

en: If you're not a romantic person, you won't want to see a love story.
cn: 如果你不是个浪漫之人，你就不会想去看爱情电影。

en: In other words, with your career, you should decide which job will suit your personality.
cn: 换句话说，对选择职业而言，你应当判断哪个工作会适合你的个性。

en: Finally, decide how to get movie tickets, and find out where the theater is before you go.
cn: 最后，决定如何去取电影票，并在去之前弄清楚电影院在哪里。

en: With your career, you need to find information about where you can work, and how to get a job in that profession.
cn: 就你的职业来说，你需要了解你可以去哪里工作，以及如何获得这个行业的工作。

en: So, how do you start?
cn: 那么，你怎么开始呢？

en: Begin by asking yourself some questions.
cn: 就从问自己一些问题开始吧。

en: Some jobs require you to have certain life experiences: Have you traveled overseas?
cn: 一些工作要求你有特定的人生经历：你是否出过国？

en: Do you have any extra certificates besides your degree, such as a first aid license, for example?
cn: 除学位证书之外你还有没有任何其他的证书，比方说急救证？

en: Your physical state and build can also affect which jobs you can do.
cn: 你的身体状况和体格可能也会影响你能够从事哪些工作。

en: A person, for example, who is allergic to cats would probably never become an animal doctor.
cn: 比方说，一个对猫过敏的人很可能永远也当不了兽医。

en: Flight attendants, firefighters, and police officers have to be over a certain height, and be physically fit.
cn: 空乘人员、消防员和警察对身高和体格都有要求。

en: Your personality matters, too.
cn: 你的个性也很紧要。

en: Are you outgoing or shy?
cn: 你是爱好交际还是性格腼腆？

en: If you like working alone, a job that requires lots of teamwork might not suit you.
cn: 如果你喜欢独自工作，需要大量团队合作的工作可能就不适合你。

en: Choosing a career can take time and a lot of thought.
cn: 选择职业可能需要花点时间，好好考虑。

en: However, when you know you can look forward to working in your dream job, you'll be glad you thought it through.
cn: 然而当你知道你能期待从事梦寐以求的工作，你将会庆幸自己把这件事想透了。

en: Kwanza is a cultural festival during which African-Americans celebrate and reflect upon their rich heritage as the products of two worlds.
cn: 宽扎节是一个文化节日，节日期间非裔美国人将庆祝并重温自己丰富的文化遗产——两个区域的产物。

en: It begins December 26th and lasts for seven days.
cn: 它始于12月26日，持续七天。

en: Kwanza was founded in 1966 by Dr. Karenga, a college professor and African-American leader, who believed that a special holiday could help African-Americans meet their goals of building strong families, learning about their history, and creating a sense of unity.
cn: 宽扎节由大学教授兼非裔美国人领袖卡伦加博士于1966年建立，他相信一个特别的节日能帮助非裔美国人达成构建稳固家庭、了解本族历史、并形成团结之感的目

en: After conducting extensive research in which he studied the festivals of many African groups of people, he decided that the new holiday should be a harvest or "first fruits" celebration, incorporating ideas from many different harvest traditions.
cn: 在开展了广泛的研究、钻研了许多非洲民族的节日之后，他决意这个新节日该是丰收或“第一批果实”的庆祝活动，吸纳诸多不同庆丰收传统的理念。

en: Kwanzaa is a Kiswahili word meaning "the first fruits of the harvest."
cn: 宽扎节是一个斯瓦希里语单词，意为“收割的第一批果实”。

en: The East African language of Kiswahili was chosen as the official language of Kwanzaa because it is a non-tribal language, spoken by a large portion of the African population.
cn: 东非语言斯瓦希里语被选定为宽扎节的官方语言，因为它是非部落语，为很大一部分非洲人所使用。

en: Also, its pronunciation is easy.
cn: 而且，其发音简单。

en: Kwanzaa is based on seven principles which are unity, self-determination, collective work and responsibility, cooperative economics, purpose, creativity and faith.
cn: 宽扎节基于七项准则，分别是团结、自主、集体工作和责任、合作经济、目的、创造和信念。

en: One principle is highlighted each day of the holiday.
cn: 节日每天强调一项准则。

en: In preparation for the celebration, a straw mat is placed on the table, along with a candle holder with seven candles, one black, three red, and three green.
cn: 准备庆祝活动时，桌上放一张草席，加以一个烛台，其上有七根蜡烛，一根黑色、三根红色、还有三根绿色。

en: The black candle represents the African-American people, the red is for their struggles, and the green represents their hopes for the future.
cn: 黑色蜡烛代表非裔美国人，红色的代表他们的斗争，绿色的代表他们对未来的期望。

en: Other items placed on the table are a variety of fruit, ears of corns, gifts, and a communal unity cup for pouring and sharing drinks.
cn: 放在桌子上的其它东西是各种各样的水果、玉米穗、礼物和用来斟倒及分享饮品的公用团结杯。

en: Each day of Kwanzaa, usually before the evening meal, family and friends gather around the table and someone lights a candle, beginning with the black.
cn: 宽扎节期间的每天，通常在晚餐前，家人和朋友会围聚在桌旁，有人会点亮一支蜡烛（从黑色的开始）。

en: After that, candles are lit alternately from left to right.
cn: 而后，蜡烛依次从左到右轮流燃起。

en: While the candle is being lit, a principle is recited; then each person present takes a turn to speak about the importance that principle has to himself or herself.
cn: 点亮蜡烛时，会诵读一项准则；然后在场的每个人轮流谈谈这项准则对他或她的重要性。

en: Next the ceremony focuses on remembering those who have died.
cn: 随后，仪式聚焦于缅怀那些死去的人。

en: A selected person pours water or juice from the unity cup into a bowl.
cn: 某个选定的人会将团结杯中的水或果汁倒入碗中。

en: That person then drinks from the cup and raises it high saying "Harambee" which means "Let's all pull together."
cn: 而后，他从杯中喝一口，再高举杯子，道“哈兰比”，意思是“让我们齐心协力”。

en: All repeat "Harambee" seven times and each person drinks from the cup.
cn: 所有人跟着说“哈兰比”七次，每个人都会从杯中喝水（或果汁）。

en: Then names of African-American leaders and heroes are called out, and everyone reflects upon the great things these people did.
cn: 之后，美国非裔领袖和英雄的名字被大声说出，人人回顾这些人做过的伟大之举。

en: The ceremony is followed by a meal, and then singing and perhaps listening to African music.
cn: 仪式后，接下来是一顿美餐，之后歌唱、也可能是聆听非洲音乐。

en: The Mediterranean diet is based upon the traditional cooking styles of countries surrounding the Mediterranean Sea.
cn: 地中海饮食是基于地中海沿岸国家的传统烹饪风格。

en: Its staples include fruits, vegetables, wine, bread, olive oil and nuts, as well as fish.
cn: 其主食包括水果、蔬菜、酒、面包、橄榄油和坚果，还有鱼。

en: Now, research projects have concluded that this diet is one of the most healthful in the world in terms of preventing heart disease and cancer, and increasing life expectancy.
cn: 如今，研究项目已得出结论，就预防心脏病和癌症以及延长预期寿命而言，这种饮食是全世界最健康的饮食之一。

en: The Mediterranean region is not one uniform geographical area, and the Mediterranean diet can be broken down into three different variants: European, North African and Middle Eastern.
cn: 地中海地区不是一个统一的地理区域，地中海饮食可分成三种不同的类型：欧洲型、北非型和中东型。

en: International interest in the therapeutic qualities of the Mediterranean diet began in the late 1950s, when the Seven Countries Study produced results that indicated that populations living in the Mediterranean region enjoyed better health and lower mortality rates, especially from heart disease, than North American and Northern European populations.
cn: 国际上对地中海饮食治疗功效的兴趣始于20世纪50年代后期，当时“七国研究”得出的结果表明，与北美和北欧人群相比，地中海地区的人口享有更好的健康和更低的死亡率，尤其是心脏病致死率。

en: The study is considered one of the greatest studies of its kind.
cn: 这项研究被认为是同类研究中规模最大的之一。

en: It gathered data on heart disease and its potential causes from nearly 13,000 men in Greece, Italy, Croatia, Serbia, Japan, Finland, the Netherlands, and the United States.
cn: 它在希腊、意大利、克罗地亚、塞尔维亚、日本、芬兰、荷兰和美国的近1.3万名男性身上收集了关于心脏病及其潜在病因的数据。

en: The study was conducted over a period of decades.
cn: 研究为期数十年。

en: It concluded that the Mediterranean people in the study enjoyed some significant health advantages.
cn: 结论是，该研究中地中海人在健康上享有某些明显优势。

en: The Mediterranean groups had lower mortality rates in all age brackets and from all causes, particularly from heart disease.
cn: 在各年龄段，地中海组因患各类疾病（尤其是心脏病）死亡的概率都比其他组低。

en: The study also showed that the Mediterranean diet is as high or higher in fat than other diets, obtaining up to 40% of all its calories from fat.
cn: 研究还表明，地中海饮食的脂肪含量和其他饮食一样高或更高，高达40%的能量从脂肪中摄取。

en: It has, however, different patterns of fat intake.
cn: 不过这种饮食所摄取脂肪的组成有所不同。

en: Mediterranean cooking uses smaller amounts of saturated fat and higher amounts of unsaturated fat, mostly in the form of olive oil.
cn: 地中海烹饪使用的饱和脂肪较少，不饱和脂肪较多，且主要以橄榄油的形式。

en: Saturated fats are fats that are found principally in meat and dairy products, although some nuts and vegetable oils also contain them.
cn: 饱和脂肪主要出现在肉类和奶制品中，尽管一些坚果和植物油中也含有饱和脂肪。

en: Saturated fats are used by the body to make cholesterol, and high levels of cholesterol have since been directly related to heart disease.
cn: 饱和脂肪被人体用以生成胆固醇，自那以后，人们将高胆固醇与心脏病直接联系起来。

en: You are going to give a short speech of thanks for the speaker this evening, aren't you?
cn: 你今晚要给演讲者做一个简短的致谢词，对吧？

en: Yes, that's right.
cn: 是的，没错。

en: You don't sound very enthusiastic.
cn: 你听起来好像不太热情。

en: But I can never forget the first speech of thanks I did.
cn: 但是我永远忘不了我第一次做致谢词的情景。

en: Well, how did that go?
cn: 嗯，那次怎么样？

en: It was a disaster.
cn: 那是一场灾难。

en: I was in my early twenties and I had just joined the local history society.
cn: 我那时候二十出头，刚刚加入当地的历史社团。

en: Anyway, I was asked to give the vote of thanks at the end of a lecture.
cn: 不管怎样，我被要求在讲座结束时致谢词。

en: She was going to give a talk with slides about our town in the 18th century.
cn: 她准备用幻灯片做一个关于我们小镇18世纪历史的讲座。

en: I knew she'd published a book on the subject, so I thought she would be quite good.
cn: 我知道她出版了一本关于这个主题的书，所以我想她会讲得很好。

en: When I arrived, the secretary asked me if I would say a few words of thanks after the lecture.
cn: 当我到达时，秘书问我是否愿意在讲座后说几句致谢词。

en: I said yes.
cn: 我说好的。

en: Anyway, from that point on, I was scared.
cn: 不管怎样，从那时起，我就害怕了。

en: I spent the whole lecture trying to make notes of interesting parts so I could thank her for them afterwards.
cn: 我整个讲座都在努力记下有趣的部分，以便之后可以感谢她。

en: In fact, by the time the lecture was over, I was feeling much better.
cn: 事实上，当讲座结束时，我感觉好多了。

en: But she was so nervous that she kept forgetting what she was going to say, and kept speaking in a whisper.
cn: 但她太紧张了，总是忘记自己要说什么，而且一直用耳语般的声音说话。

en: The audience kept calling out "We can't hear you!"
cn: 观众不停地喊：“我们听不见！”

en: At least the slides were good, that is, until the bulb in the projector blew.
cn: 至少幻灯片还不错，这是说，直到投影机的灯泡爆掉。

en: And she had to finish her talk with no illustrations.
cn: 所以她没法用幻灯片，只能口头完成演讲。

en: So what did you say in your speech of thanks?
cn: 那么你在致谢词里说了什么？

en: What can you say?
cn: 你还能说什么呢？

en: You have to be polite.
cn: 你总得客气。

en: I mentioned the interesting facts, referred to the excellent slides, and then finished up by saying "We'd all like to thank Miss Bligh for blowing us her slides."
cn: 我提到了有趣的内容，提到了精美的幻灯片，最后说：“我们都要感谢布莱小姐为我们搞砸了她的幻灯片。”

en: Oh, no.
cn: 哦，不会吧。

en: I felt terrible.
cn: 我觉得糟透了。

en: I tried to apologize, not very successfully.
cn: 我尝试道歉，但没起太大作用。

en: And the speech of thanks this evening?
cn: 那今晚的致谢词？

en: I'll write down exactly what I'm going to say and read it carefully.
cn: 我会把自己要说的话原原本本写下来，念的时候特别小心。

en: Another cup of tea, Paul?
cn: 保罗，再来杯茶？

en: No, thanks.
cn: 不用了，谢谢。

en: Well, what's new, Laury?
cn: 嗯，有什么新鲜事吗，劳丽？

en: Nothing dramatic.
cn: 没什么特别引人注目的。

en: But there is something you should know about.
cn: 但有件事你应该了解一下。

en: What's that?
cn: 什么事？

en: Well, our rivals are offering extended credit terms to some of the retailers in the area.
cn: 我们的竞争对手正在对该地区的部分零售商提供信贷延期条款。

en: Oh?
cn: 哦？

en: Which rival is this?
cn: 哪个对手？

en: We only have two.
cn: 我们只有两个对手。

en: Barratts Company.
cn: 巴拉茨公司。

en: Oh, them.
cn: 哦，他们呀。

en: Well, they are hardly a threat.
cn: 他们算不上威胁。

en: I know they are smaller than us, but we can't afford to ignore them.
cn: 我知道他们比我们公司小，但我们可承受不起忽视他们的代价。

en: Yes, you are right, Laury.
cn: 是的，说得对，劳丽。

en: But I don't like extended credit.
cn: 但我不喜欢信贷延期。

en: It ties up cash we could put to better use elsewhere.
cn: 它会占用我们本可以更好地用在其他地方的资金。

en: But, I'll look into it on Monday.
cn: 不过，我会在周一研究研究。

en: Yes.
cn: 好的。

en: And there is something else.
cn: 还有一件事。

en: Don't tell me!
cn: 先别说！

en: The letter from the tax revenue office?
cn: 是不是税务局来信了？

en: Right.
cn: 对。

en: How did you know?
cn: 你怎么知道的？

en: Tara told me.
cn: 塔拉告诉我的。

en: What's the problem?
cn: 有什么问题吗？

en: Well.
cn: 嗯。

en: Tom got this letter late yesterday and then went frantic trying to find copies of last year's accounts.
cn: 汤姆昨天晚上时候得到的这封信，之后他就在找去年账目的复印件，找得他抓狂了。

en: Did he find them?
cn: 他找着了吗？

en: No.
cn: 没有。

en: And he was away before I could get hold of the letter.
cn: 我还没看到那封信，他就离开了。

en: How about a drive down to the office now?
cn: 那我们现在开车去办公室怎么样？

en: And we'll see if everything's all right.
cn: 去看看是否一切顺利。

en: There's another reason why I wanted a chat with you before Monday.
cn: 我周一之前想和你谈谈的原因还有一个。

en: I thought as much.
cn: 我觉得也是。

en: Well, go on, surprise me.
cn: 那你说吧，让我惊讶惊讶。

en: How about selling that new motorcycle of yours in Indonesia?
cn: 把你的那款新摩托车卖到印度尼西亚去，怎么样？

en: What?
cn: 什么？

en: You mean export?
cn: 你是说出口？

en: Paul, I think you've been away too long.
cn: 保罗，我觉得你离开得太久了。

en: This is Jayal Motors.
cn: 这可是杰奥摩托。

en: We've never sold a bike abroad.
cn: 我们从来没有在国外卖过摩托车。

en: Don't worry, Laury.
cn: 没事，劳丽。

en: I'm not crazy.
cn: 我没疯。

en: I've been studying the possibility and I think we should give it a go.
cn: 我一直在研究这种可能性，我觉得我们应该试一试。

en: It's not as easy as that though, is it?
cn: 可这并没有那么容易，不是吗？

en: We'd have to reorganize the whole company.
cn: 我们必须得对公司上下进行重组。

en: Don't be silly.
cn: 别傻了。

en: I don't intend starting next week.
cn: 我并不打算下周就开始。

en: We'll have to plan it properly.
cn: 我们得做出合理的规划。

en: Of course, there will be a few problems...
cn: 当然会有一些问题……

en: A few problems?
cn: 一些？

en: I can see hundreds.
cn: 我看问题可不少。

en: For one thing, transport.
cn: 首先，运输就是个问题。

en: I have enough trouble delivering bikes to shops only 40 miles away, never mind 5,000 miles!
cn: 把摩托车运到仅40英里远的商店带来的麻烦就够多了，更别提5000英里了！

en: That's what forwarding agents are for.
cn: 运输代理就是干这个的。

en: A report on sleep and nutrition released this month found that people who consistently went to bed earlier than 11 p.m. took in fewer calories and ate more healthy food.
cn: 本月发布的一份关于睡眠和营养的报告发现，坚持晚上11点前睡觉的人摄入的卡路里更少，吃的健康食物更多。

en: In contrast, "night owls" who go to bed between 11 p.m. and 3 a.m. tend to consume more coffee, alcohol, refined sugars and processed meats than early risers.
cn: 相反，在晚上11点至凌晨3点睡觉的“夜猫子”比早起的人摄入更多咖啡、酒精、精制糖类和加工肉类。

en: This report corresponds with the existing scientific literature on bedtime and wellness.
cn: 该报告与现有关于就寝时间和健康的科学文献一致。

en: The relationship between getting more sleep and making better food choices is well-documented.
cn: “获得更多睡眠”与“做出更好的食物选择”之间的关系有充分的证据支持。

en: A study published last year in The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition found that people who sleep more tend to eat less unhealthy food than their peers who don't get as much rest.
cn: 去年发表于《美国临床营养学杂志》的一项研究发现，与睡眠不足的同龄人相比，睡眠时间更长的人更少吃不健康食物。

en: And a 2015 study from the University of California, Berkeley found that teens who go to bed late are more likely to gain weight over a five-year period.
cn: 2015年加州大学伯克利分校一项研究发现，晚睡的青少年更容易在五年内发胖。

en: As a group, "night owl" types tend to eat less healthy food and take in more calories overall than early risers.
cn: 整体看来，“夜猫子”类型的人比早起的人吃更少的健康食物，摄入更多的卡路里。

en: The later one goes to bed, the more calories one records the next day.
cn: 一个人睡得越晚，第二天记录（所摄入）的卡路里就越多。

en: As yet a challenge to explain the cause-and-effect relationship between sleep and nutrition, there may be a third factor that impacts both of them.
cn: 然而，要解释睡眠和营养之间的因果关系还有一个问题，那就是可能有第三个因素影响着这两者。

en: Or the relationship could be reversed, that is, people who eat less fall asleep earlier.
cn: 或者，这种关系也可能倒过来，即吃得少的人睡得更早。

en: Still, if late sleepers want to lose a few pounds, they can go to bed earlier than they usually do, thereby, reducing their chances of taking snacks before bedtime.
cn: 不过，如果晚睡的人想减掉几磅，可以比平时更早睡觉，这样就能减少在睡前吃零食的机会。

en: Researchers have found not just a diversity problem in Hollywood but actually an inclusion crisis.
cn: 研究者们发现好莱坞存在的不仅仅是多样性问题，实际上是一种包容性危机。

en: With less than a week before an Oscars ceremony that has already been criticized for an all-white list of acting nominees, a study shows the film industry does worse than television.
cn: 在奥斯卡颁奖典礼举行不到一周之前，这场颁奖典礼已经因为全白人的演员提名名单而招致批评，一项研究显示，电影业比电视业更糟糕。

en: Just 3.4 percent of film directors were female, and only 7 percent of films had a cast whose balance of race and ethnicity reflected the country's diversity.
cn: 只有3.4%的电影导演是女性，只有7%的电影拥有“种族和族裔间平衡反映本国（种族和族裔）多样性”的演员阵容。

en: When researchers looked at all TV shows, they also found that women of color over 40 were regarded as "largely invisible" and just 22 percent of TV series creators were female.
cn: 当研究人员查看所有电视节目时，他们还发现，40岁以上的有色人种女性被认为是“基本看不到”，且仅有22%的电视剧创作者是女性。

en: Overall, the study found half the films and TV shows had no Asian speaking characters and more than one-fifth of them had no black characters with dialogue.
cn: 总的来说，这项研究发现，一半的电影和电视剧中没有说亚洲语言的角色，超过五分之一没有带台词的黑人角色。

en: The film industry still functions as a straight, white, boy's club.
cn: 电影业仍是一个纯粹的白人男性俱乐部。

en: When looking at how women are depicted, the study found female characters were four times more likely to be shown in sexy clothing and nearly four times as likely to be referred to as physically attractive.
cn: 在研究女性是如何被刻画时，研究发现，女性角色以性感着装示人的机率为男性的四倍，而且被认为外表迷人的机率也是男性的近四倍。

en: But their results also indicated films and TV shows with women or people of color in the important jobs behind the scenes—director, producer or writer—tended to have better diversity numbers.
cn: 但他们的结果还表明，女性或有色人种在幕后担任重要工作——导演，制片人或作家——的电影或电视剧往往呈现的多样性数字更佳。

en: Across TV and film, the underrepresentation of non-white characters falls mostly on Hispanics.
cn: 在整个影视业中，非白人角色的代表性不足主要集中在拉美裔身上。

en: Among more than 10,000 characters, proportions of white, black and Asian characters came close to U.S. population figures.
cn: 在超过10,000个角色中，白人，黑人和亚裔的比例接近美国相应的人口比例。

en: But Hispanics were just 5.8 percent of characters, despite being about 17 percent of the U.S. population.
cn: 但拉美裔只占人物角色的5.8%，尽管拉美裔占据了美国总人口的约17%。

en: When purchasing life insurance, there are many important factors to consider.
cn: 购买人寿保险时，有许多重要因素需要考虑。

en: One should buy the policies that give the most protection at the least cost, insure the right family members, and consider the family's financial needs.
cn: 人们应该购买“以最低价格提供最大保障，为恰当的家庭成员投保，且考虑到家庭经济需求”的保单。

en: It is important to buy the insurance from companies that are financially sound and that are represented by honest, well-trained agents.
cn: 至关重要的是，要从自身财力雄厚，代理人诚实正直、训练有素的公司购买保险。

en: At various stages in a person's life, different kinds of life insurance are needed for particular situations.
cn: 在人生的不同阶段，不同境况需要不同的寿险。

en: Jerry is single and has no dependents.
cn: 杰瑞单身，没有依赖他生活的人。

en: Probably the only life insurance he needs is enough to cover his debts and burial expenses.
cn: 可能他唯一需要的寿险就是足够负担他的债务和殡葬费用的（寿险）。

en: Insurance can be purchased at a lower rate during the young years, but by buying while young, the premiums are paid in for a longer period of time.
cn: 保险可在年轻时以较低费率购入，但年轻时购买保险需要缴纳保费的时间更长。

en: In the end, the amount paid for premiums is about the same.
cn: 最后，缴纳的保费数额几乎是一样的。

en: A person shouldn't buy insurance protection that really isn't necessary.
cn: 人们不应购买着实不必要的保险保障。

en: Suppose that Jerry marries Jeannette, who is a college graduate and is working.
cn: 假设杰瑞娶了珍妮特，她大学毕业且在职工作。

en: Perhaps enough insurance should be needed to cover their debts and burial expenses.
cn: 可能（他们）需要足够的保险来负担他们的债务和殡葬费用。

en: Now, Jeannette has quit work and their first child is on the way.
cn: 现在，珍妮特辞去了工作，他们第一个孩子即将出生。

en: They have purchased a home with a small down payment and a 30-year mortgage.
cn: 他们已经以小额首付和30年抵押贷款买了房子。

en: The situation regarding life insurance takes on a different look.
cn: 就寿险而言，情形如今成了另一番模样。

en: There are dependents who need financial protection.
cn: 现在有了需要经济保护的受扶养人。

en: How much insurance is needed?
cn: 需要多少保险呢？

en: As the family increases in size, it is essential to add more insurance on the breadwinner to protect the dependents.
cn: 随着家庭规模扩大，非常有必要在养家人身上增投保险、以保护受托养人。

en: When the children are young and depend upon the family for financial needs, families with modest incomes have difficulty providing enough life insurance to protect the mother and the children.
cn: 在孩子年幼、倚赖家庭满足经济需要时，收入微薄的家庭难以提供足够的寿险来保护母亲和孩子。

en: Families with modest incomes should insure the breadwinner or breadwinners first.
cn: 收入微薄的家庭应优先为养家人（注：指父母中的一方或双方）投保。

en: When considering the amount of insurance for the mother with dependent children, substitute childcare is a need that should be planned for until the children can care for themselves.
cn: 当考虑到有待抚养子女的母亲的保险额时，替代性儿童照料应纳入计划，直到孩子可以照顾自己。

en: The death of a small child would have no effect upon the income of the family.
cn: 小孩的去世不会影响家庭收入。

en: Perhaps a policy to meet funeral expenses would be sufficient for the young child, although most people do not take out insurance on their young children.
cn: 也许一份能偿付葬礼费用的保单对他们来说就足够了，然而多数人不会为他们的小孩办理保险。

en: As the children become financially independent of the family, the emphasis on family financial security will shift from protection to saving for the retirement years.
cn: 随着孩子财务独立，家庭经济保障的重心会由（为孩子提供）保护转移至为退休岁月存款。

en: Every family situation is different, but it is important that each family give adequate thought to planning its financial future.
cn: 每个家庭情况不同，但是充分考虑将来的理财很重要。

en: "Stereotype" may sound like a bad word, but there's nothing bad about it.
cn: “刻板印象”可能听起来是一个不好的词，但它本身没什么不好。

en: For one thing, stereotypes are often accurate.
cn: 首先，刻板印象往往是准确的。

en: When you ask people about their concept of stereotypes, they get it pretty much right.
cn: 当你询问人们对于刻板印象的概念时，他们的理解八九不离十。

en: Also, stereotypes are often positive, particularly of groups that we ourselves belong to.
cn: 此外，刻板印象通常是正面的，特别是对于我们自己所属的集体而言。

en: Some of the statistical generalizations may be positive as some groups have reputations for being smart, for being loyal, for being brave, for all sorts of things that are not at all negative.
cn: 某些基于统计数据的概括可能是正面的，有些团体以聪明、忠诚、勇敢，以及各种绝非负面的品质而著称。

en: And so there's nothing inherently wrong about stereotypes.
cn: 因此刻板印象本身没错。

en: But there are problems with stereotypes.
cn: 但是刻板印象（的确）存在问题。

en: For one thing, they're reliable insofar as they're based on unbiased samples.
cn: 首先，只有基于无偏样本的刻板印象才是可靠的。

en: But a lot of the information we get about human groups is through biased sources like how they're represented in the media.
cn: 但是我们很多关于人类群体的知识都是通过诸如媒体报道等有偏来源获得的。

en: And if these sources don't give you an accurate depiction, your stereotype won't be accurate.
cn: 而如果这些来源不能为你提供一个准确的描述，你得到的刻板印象自然也不会准确。

en: For example, many Jews have been troubled by Shakespeare's depiction of Shylock.
cn: 例如，很多犹太人因莎士比亚对夏洛克的描写而感到困扰。

en: If the only Jew you know is Shakespeare's Shylock, it's going to be a very bad impression.
cn: 如果你知道的唯一一位犹太人是夏洛克的话，这将是极差的一个印象。

en: So one problem with stereotypes is while we are good at drawing conclusions from them, often our information isn't reliable.
cn: 因此刻板印象的一个问题在于，虽然我们擅于从中得出结论，但我们获得的信息往往并不可靠。

en: A second problem is that stereotypes, regardless of whether or not they're accurate, can have a negative effect on the people that they apply to.
cn: 第二个问题在于，刻板印象不管准确与否，都可能对它们所适用的人们产生负面的影响。

en: And this is what psychologist, Claude Steele, described as stereotype threat.
cn: 而这种影响正是心理学家克劳德·斯蒂尔提出的刻板印象威胁。

en: He has a vivid example of this.
cn: 在这一问题上，他有一个生动的实例。

en: Here's how to make African-Americans do worse on a math test.
cn: 那就是如何让非裔美国人在数学考试中表现得更差。

en: Arrange a test, and just before it starts, make certain that they have to identify their race.
cn: 安排一项（数学）测试，并在举行测试时要求他们必须写明自己的种族。

en: The very act of acknowledging that they are African-Americans when given a test ignites in them thoughts of their own stereotype which is negative regarding academics and that makes them do worse.
cn: 在接受测试时承认自己是非裔美国人这一行为本身，点燃了他们心中关于学术的负面刻板印象，从而使他们表现得更差。

en: Want to know how to make a woman do worse on a math test?
cn: 想知道如何使女性在数学测试中表现更差吗？

en: Same thing, get her to write down her sex.
cn: 同样的，让她写下自己的性别（就可以了）。

en: One recent study found a sort of clever twist on this.
cn: 最近一项研究发现了对这一做法的一种巧妙转化。

en: When Asian-American women are given a test and they're asked to mark down their race, they do better than they would otherwise do.
cn: 当美国亚裔女性在接受测试时被要求写下她们的种族，她们的表现比不写时更好。

en: They're reminded of a positive stereotype that boosts their morale.
cn: （因为）这种做法让她们想起正面的刻板印象，从而鼓舞了她们的士气。

en: You ask them, on the other hand, to mark down their sex, they do worse because they're reminded of a negative stereotype.
cn: 而另一方面，你要是让她们写下自己的性别，她们表现更差，这是因为这让她们想起了负面的刻板印象。

en: That's an example of how stereotypes have a potentially damaging effect on people.
cn: 这个例子体现了刻板印象如何对人们产生潜在的有害影响。

en: Sometimes when you take a common drug, you may have a side effect.
cn: 有时你服用一种普通药物可能会出现副作用。

en: That is, the drug may cause some effect other than its intended one.
cn: 也就是说，这种药物可能引起了预期作用以外的某种作用。

en: When these side effects occur, they are called adverse reactions.
cn: 当这些副作用出现时，它们被称之为不良反应。

en: Whenever you have an adverse reaction, you should stop taking the drug right away.
cn: 无论何时出现不良反应，你都应当立即停止服药。

en: Ask your pharmacist whether he can suggest a drug that will relieve the symptoms but that will not cause the adverse reaction.
cn: 咨询你的药剂师是否能建议一种既可缓解症状、又不会引起不良反应的药物。

en: If an adverse reaction to a drug is serious, consult your doctor for advice at once.
cn: 如果你对一种药物的不良反应十分严重，应当立即咨询医师。

en: Drugs that are safe in the dosage stated on the label may be very dangerous in large doses.
cn: 按标签剂量服用时安全的药物，大剂量服用时也可能会很危险。

en: For example, aspirin is seldom thought of as dangerous, but there are many reports of accidental poisoning of young children who take too many aspirin pills as well as the possible development of Reye's syndrome in children with flu.
cn: 比如，阿司匹林很少被认为有危害，却有许多关于“幼儿因服用过量阿司匹林而意外中毒，以及流感患儿服用（阿司匹林）可能引发急性脑病综合症”的报道。

en: In adults, excessive use of some painkilling drugs may cause severe kidney damage.
cn: 在成年人中，过量服用某些止痛药可能导致肾脏功能严重受损。

en: Some drugs for relief of stomach upsets, when taken in excess, can perhaps cause serious digestive problems.
cn: 某些用于缓解胃部不适的药物，服用过量时可能引起严重的消化问题。

en: You should never use any over-the-counter drug on a regular, continued basis, or in large quantities, except on your doctor's advice.
cn: 除非遵照医嘱，否则你绝不能频繁、持续地或大量地服用任何非处方药。

en: You could be suffering from a serious illness that needs a doctor's care.
cn: 你的病痛之苦可能需要接受医生的治疗。

en: Each drug you take not only acts on the body but may also alter the effect of any other drug you are taking.
cn: 每一种你服用的药物不仅作用于你的身体，还可能改变你所服用的其他药物的效果。

en: Sometimes this can cause dangerous or even fatal reactions.
cn: 有时这可能导致危险的，甚至是致命的反应。

en: For example, aspirin increases the blood-thinning effects of drugs given to patients with heart disease.
cn: 比如阿司匹林会加剧心脏病患者所服药物的血液稀释效应。

en: Therefore, a patient who has been taking such a drug may risk bleeding if he or she uses aspirin for a headache.
cn: 因此，服用心脏病药物的患者若再服用阿司匹林治疗头疼可能会有出血的风险。

en: Before using several drugs together you should ask your doctor and follow his advice.
cn: 在同时服用几种药物之前，你应该先咨询医师并遵循医嘱。

en: Your pharmacist can tell you whether certain drugs can safely be taken together.
cn: 你的药剂师会告诉你某些药物一起服用是否安全。

en: Alcohol may increase the effect of a drug — sleeping pills combine with alcohol to produce a sleepy feeling.
cn: 饮酒可能会增强药物的效果——安眠药与酒同服会令人昏昏欲睡。

en: When taking any drug, you should ask your doctor whether drinking alcohol could be dangerous in combination with medicine.
cn: 服用任何药物时，都应咨询医师该药若与酒同服会否有危险。

en: Experts believe there is a relationship between adult abuse of legitimate medicines and the drug culture that has swept our country.
cn: 专家认为，“成年人滥用合法药物”与“席卷全国的毒品文化”有一定关联。

en: You can do your share to reduce the chances that your children will become part of the drug culture by treating all medicines with respect.
cn: 你可以通过“谨慎对待每一种药物”来出一份力，降低你的孩子成为毒品文化一部分的几率。

en: Always let your children know that medicines and drugs should not be used carelessly.
cn: 无论何时都要让你的孩子知道，药物和药品不得草率使用。

en: What's all that?
cn: 那是什么？

en: Are you going to make a salad?
cn: 你要做沙拉吗？

en: No, I'm going to make a gazpacho.
cn: 不，我要做gazpacho。

en: What's that?
cn: 那是什么？

en: Gazpacho is a cold soup from Spain.
cn: gazpacho是一种来自西班牙的冷汤。

en: It's mostly vegetables.
cn: 它主要是蔬菜。

en: I guess you can call it a liquid salad.
cn: 我想你也可以叫它液体沙拉。

en: Cold soup?
cn: 冷汤？

en: Sounds weird.
cn: 听起来怪怪的。

en: It's delicious.
cn: 很好吃的。

en: Trust me.
cn: 相信我。

en: I tried it for the first time during my summer vacation in Spain.
cn: 我在西班牙度暑假的时候第一次吃。

en: You see, in the south of Spain, it gets very hot in the summer, up to 42 degrees Celsius.
cn: 你看，在西班牙南部，夏天很热，气温高达42摄氏度。

en: So a cold gazpacho is very refreshing.
cn: 所以冷的gazpacho非常清爽。

en: The main ingredients are tomato, cucumber, bell peppers, olive oil and stale bread.
cn: 它的主要原料是西红柿、黄瓜、柿子椒、橄榄油和陈面包。

en: Stale bread?
cn: 陈面包？

en: Surely you mean bread for dipping into the soup?
cn: 你肯定是指蘸汤的面包吧？

en: No.
cn: 不是的。

en: Bread is crushed and blended in like everything else.
cn: 面包和其他原料一样，都是碾碎、加入汤中的。

en: It adds texture and thickness to the soup.
cn: 它增加了汤的口感和浓度。

en: Mm.
cn: 嗯。

en: And is it healthy?
cn: 这健康吗？

en: Sure.
cn: 当然了。

en: As I said earlier, it's mostly vegetables.
cn: 就像我刚才所说的，它主要是蔬菜。

en: You can also add different things if you like, such as half-boiled eggs or cured ham.
cn: 如果你喜欢的话，也可以加入不同的东西，比如半熟的鸡蛋或腌制火腿。

en: Cured ham?
cn: 腌制火腿？

en: What's that?
cn: 那是什么？

en: That's another Spanish delicacy.
cn: 那是另一种西班牙美食。

en: Have you never heard of it?
cn: 你没听说过吗？

en: It's quite famous.
cn: 它很有名的。

en: No.
cn: 没有。

en: Is it good too?
cn: 这也很好吃吗？

en: Oh, yeah, definitely.
cn: 噢，是的，当然了。

en: It's amazing.
cn: 它的味道很棒。

en: It's a little dry and salty, and it's very expensive because it comes from a special type of pig that only eats a special type of food.
cn: 它有一点干和咸，而且很贵，因为是取自一种特殊品种的猪，这种猪只吃一种特殊的饲料。

en: The ham is covered in salt to dry and preserve it, and left to hang for up to two years.
cn: 火腿用盐覆盖以干燥和保存，并悬挂长达两年。

en: It has a very distinct flavor.
cn: 它具有一种非常特殊的味道。

en: Mm.
cn: 嗯。

en: Sounds interesting.
cn: 听起来很有趣。

en: Where can I find some?
cn: 在哪里能找到？

en: It used to be difficult to get Spanish produce here.
cn: 以前很难在这里买到西班牙产品。

en: But it's now a lot more common.
cn: 但现在常见多了。

en: Most large supermarket chains have cured ham in little packets, but in Spain you can buy a whole leg.
cn: 大多数大型连锁超市都有小包装的腌制火腿，但在西班牙，你能买到一整条火腿。

en: A whole pig leg?
cn: 一整条猪腿？

en: Why would anybody want so much ham?
cn: 为什么有人要这么多火腿？

en: In Spain, many people buy a whole leg for special group events such as Christmas.
cn: 在西班牙，许多人会为圣诞节之类的特殊集体活动买一整条火腿。

en: They cut it themselves into very thin slices with a long flat knife.
cn: 他们会自己用一把又长又平的刀把它切成很薄的薄片。

en: Hello, I wish to buy a bottle of wine.
cn: 你好，我想买一瓶葡萄酒。

en: Hi, yes.
cn: 嗨，好的。

en: What kind of wine would you like?
cn: 您喜欢哪种葡萄酒？

en: I don't know.
cn: 我不知道。

en: Sorry, I don't know much about wine.
cn: 抱歉，我对葡萄酒不太了解。

en: That's no problem at all.
cn: 完全不成问题。

en: What's the occasion and how much would you like to spend?
cn: 请问是什么场合，您的预算是多少呢？

en: It's for my boss.
cn: 是想送给老板。

en: It's his birthday.
cn: 他过生日。

en: I know he likes wine, but I don't know what type.
cn: 我知道他喜欢葡萄酒，但我不知道他喜欢哪种。

en: I also do not want anything too expensive, maybe mid-range.
cn: 我也不想要太贵的，大概中档的就可以。

en: How much would you say is a mid-range bottle of wine approximately?
cn: 一瓶中档的葡萄酒大约多少钱？

en: Well, it varies greatly.
cn: 嗯，价位差别很大。

en: Our lowest prices are around $6 a bottle, but those are table wines.
cn: 我们最便宜的是一瓶6美元左右，但那些是佐餐酒。

en: They are not very special.
cn: 并不是什么很特别的酒。

en: I would not suggest them as a gift.
cn: 我不建议把它们当作礼物。

en: On the other end, our most expensive bottles are over $150.
cn: 另一方面，我们这里最贵的酒超过150美元。

en: If you are looking for something priced in the middle, I would say anything between $30 and $60 would make a decent gift.
cn: 如果您在找中间价位的酒，我觉得30到60美元的酒用来送人很体面。

en: How does that sound?
cn: 您觉得可以吗？

en: Mm, yeah.
cn: 嗯，行。

en: I guess something in the vicinity of 30 or 40 would be good.
cn: 我想30或40美元左右的酒会比较合适。

en: Which type would you recommend?
cn: 你推荐哪种酒？

en: I would say the safest option is always a red wine.
cn: 我想说最保险的选择永远都是红葡萄酒。

en: They are generally more popular than whites, and can usually be paired with food more easily.
cn: 它整体上比白葡萄酒更受欢迎，通常也更容易和菜肴搭配。

en: Our specialty here are Italian wines, and these tend to be fruity with medium acidity.
cn: 我们这里的特色是意大利葡萄酒，这些酒一般果味浓、酸度中等。

en: This one here is a Chianti, which is perhaps Italy's most famous type of red wine.
cn: 这一瓶是基安蒂，它差不多是最著名的意大利红酒。

en: Alternatively, you may wish to try and surprise your boss with something less common, such as this Zinfandel.
cn: 或者，您要想给老板来个惊喜的话可以试试冷门一些的酒，比如这瓶仙粉黛。

en: The grapes are originally native to Croatia but this winery is in eastern Italy and it has a more spicy and peppery flavor.
cn: 它所用葡萄原产于克罗地亚，酒庄位于意大利东部，味道更为辛辣，带有较多胡椒味。

en: So to summarize, the Chianti is more classical and the Zinfandel more exciting.
cn: 总而言之，基安蒂更加古典，仙粉黛更令人振奋。

en: Both are similarly priced at just under $40.
cn: 两者价格相近，都不到40美元。

en: I will go with Chianti then.
cn: 那么我就选基安蒂吧。

en: Thanks.
cn: 谢谢。

en: Many people enjoy secret codes.
cn: 许多人喜欢密码。

en: The harder the code, the more some people will try to figure it out.
cn: 密码越难，越会有人想要破解它。

en: In wartime, codes are especially important.
cn: 在战时，密码尤其重要。

en: They help army send news about battles and the size of enemy forces.
cn: 它们帮助军队传送战斗和敌军规模的相关情报。

en: Neither side wants its codes broken by the other.
cn: 任何一方都不希望自己的密码遭到另一方破解。

en: One very important code was never broken.
cn: 有一种极为重要的密码从未被破解。

en: It was used during World War II by the Americans.
cn: 它在二战期间由美国人使用。

en: It was a spoken code never written down.
cn: 它是一种从未写下来的口头密码。

en: And it was developed and used by Navajo Indians.
cn: 它由纳瓦霍印第安人发明和使用。

en: They were called "the Navajo code talkers".
cn: 而他们就被称为“纳瓦霍密码通讯员”。

en: The Navajos created the code in their own language.
cn: 纳瓦霍人用他们自己的语言创建了密码。

en: Navajo is hard to learn and only a few people know it.
cn: 纳瓦霍语很难学，懂的人很少。

en: So it was pretty certain that the enemy would not be able to understand the code talkers.
cn: 因此，敌人肯定听不懂密码通讯员说的话。

en: In addition, the talkers used code words.
cn: 此外，密码通讯员用的是暗语。

en: They called a submarine an iron fish and a small bomb thrown by hand a potato.
cn: 他们把潜艇叫作铁鱼，把手榴弹叫作土豆。

en: If they wanted to spell something, they used code words for letters of the alphabet.
cn: 要是他们想拼什么单词，他们会用暗语来表示字母表中的字母。

en: For instance, the letter A was ant or apple or ax.
cn: 例如，字母A就是“蚂蚁”或“苹果”或“斧子”。

en: The code talkers worked mostly in the islands in the Pacific.
cn: 密码通讯员主要在太平洋岛屿工作。

en: One or two would be assigned to a group of soldiers.
cn: 每队士兵配有一到两名（密码通讯员）。

en: They would send messages by field telephone to the code talker in the next group.
cn: 他们通过野战电话给另一队的密码通讯员发送消息。

en: And he would relay the information to his commander.
cn: 然后再由他把情报转给指挥官。

en: The code talkers played an important part in several battles.
cn: 密码通讯员在数场战役中发挥了重要作用。

en: They helped troops coordinate their movements and attacks.
cn: 他们帮助部队协调行动和进攻。

en: After the war, the U.S. government honored them for what they had accomplished.
cn: 战后，美国政府对他们的成就进行了表彰。

en: Theirs was the most successful wartime code ever used.
cn: 纳瓦霍密码是有史以来最成功的战时密码。

en: If you are young and thinking about your career, you'll want to know where you can make a living.
cn: 如果你还年轻，正在思索自己的职业生涯，你可能想知道自己可以在哪个行业谋生。

en: Well, there's going to be a technological replacement of a lot of knowledge-intensive jobs in the next 20 years, particularly in the two largest sectors of the labor force with professional skills.
cn: 未来二十年，许多知识密集型工作将被技术所取代，特别是在最大的两个需要专业技能的劳动力行业。

en: One is teaching and the other healthcare.
cn: 一个是教育，另一个是医疗。

en: You have so many applications and software and platforms that are going to come in and provide information and service in these two fields, which means a lot of healthcare and education sectors will be radically changed and a lot of jobs will be lost.
cn: 现在的许多应用、软件和平台都将进入这两个领域，为之提供信息和服务，这意味着许多医疗和教育行业将经历剧烈的变革，许多岗位将消失。

en: Now, where will the new jobs be found?
cn: 现在，我们将在哪些领域发现新的岗位呢？

en: Well, the one sector of the economy that can't be easily duplicated by even smart technologies is the caring sector—the personal care sector.
cn: 有一种经济部门，即便智能技术也难以复制，那就是护理业——私人护理业。

en: That is, you can't really get a robot to do a great massage or physical therapy, or you can't get the kind of personal attention you need with regard to therapy or any other personal service.
cn: 更确切地说，你不可能真正地让机器人提供舒适的按摩或理疗，或者说不可能得到那种你需要从治疗或其他私人服务那里得到的私人关怀。

en: There could be very high-end personal services.
cn: （未来）可能出现非常高端的私人服务。

en: Therapists do charge a lot of money.
cn: 治疗师收费的确很高。
