en: It turns out that the less skilled pianist spends more time looking at her fingers than does the expert who, in contrast, is more likely to be looking at the sheet of music, or looking ahead at keys he's not yet playing.
cn: 结果表明，不够娴熟的钢琴演奏者会比行家花更多时间看手指，而后者与之相反，更可能看乐谱，或是看还没弹奏的琴键。

en: In general, the expert's gaze was calmer and more stable.
cn: 总之，行家的目光更为平静稳重。

en: This is not a surprising finding.
cn: 这一发现并不令人惊讶。

en: It supports what we might almost think of as conventional wisdom.
cn: 它证实了我们也许视作为传统智慧的东西。

en: But it's remarkable for all that, nonetheless.
cn: 但即便如此，也非常了不起。

en: The eye tracker gives expert and learning performers a glimpse into what they do without thinking about it.
cn: 眼动仪让行家和学习者窥见自己无意识状态下所做的事。

en: The topic of the nature of skill—and the differences between beginners and experts—has been one of considerable discussion in cognitive science and philosophy.
cn: “技能的本质以及初学者与行家的区别”已是认知科学和哲学领域的热议话题。

en: Every summer when I top up my selection of summer outfits from the department stores, my eyes would nearly pop out of my head.
cn: 每年夏天当我从百货商店挑选夏装补充衣橱时，我的眼睛几乎都要瞪出来了。

en: I'm overwhelmed with a wide range of different slimming products each year.
cn: 每年五花八门的瘦身产品都让我惊讶万分。

en: And more shockingly, these products are often advocated by very slim models.
cn: 更让我震惊的是，这些产品的推广模特往往极瘦。

en: Having lived in Asia for almost 10 years now, I've seen various dieting tips come and go.
cn: 现在我在亚洲生活了近十个年头，见过各种节食窍门的来来去去。

en: I remember in Japan, people heading directly to the fruit section in the supermarket, when the banana diet was at its peak.
cn: 我记得在日本，香蕉节食法最热的时候，人们一进超市就直奔水果区。

en: Then there was the black tea and oolong tea diet, followed by the soybean diet and the tomato juice diet.
cn: 随后出现了红茶和乌龙茶节食法，接着是大豆节食法和番茄汁节食法。

en: The list goes on and on.
cn: 类似的节食法数不胜数。

en: Apart from what people eat, I've also seen many interesting slimming products.
cn: 除了吃的，我还见过许多有趣的瘦身产品。

en: In Hong Kong, I've seen girls wrapping their whole body or both legs up with a special type of slimming tape which is supposed to help make them thinner.
cn: 我见过香港的女孩用一种特殊的瘦身带包裹全身或双腿，据说这样能让她们变瘦。

en: But it just reminded me of the roasted ham my mother usually puts on the dinner table at Christmas.
cn: 但这却让我想起我母亲常在圣诞节时端上餐桌的烤火腿。

en: Then there were the face slimming rollers that were said to improve your blood circulation and make your face smaller.
cn: 还有滚轮瘦脸器，据说可以改善血液循环，使你的脸变小。

en: Personally I do not believe in any of these slimming gadgets and I think I have a very different perspective when it comes to the definition of what is beautiful.
cn: 我个人完全不相信这些瘦身工具，而且提到“美”的定义，我想我有着完全不同的看法。

en: Asian women prefer to avoid the sun, because being pale or white is considered beautiful whereas a tanned complexion is considered much more beautiful and sexy in the West.
cn: 亚洲女性不愿晒太阳，因为她们以苍白或白皙为美，而在西方，晒黑的肤色被认为要美丽性感得多。

en: It is most certainly shaped by a person's culture as well as how they were raised in their childhood.
cn: 几乎可以肯定，它（对美的定义）是由个人所处的文化以及童年时期所接受的教育塑造而成的。

en: When summer comes, people are inevitably influenced by this pressure to look good.
cn: 每年夏季来临之际，人们都不可避免地受到这种审美的影响。

en: But it's not just women who are affected by the pressure to stay in good shape.
cn: 但受这种“维持良好外形”压力影响的不只女性。

en: Men also want to look like they have a six-pack and a V-shaped back, and the slimming market for men is also expanding.
cn: 男性也希望自己能秀秀六块腹肌和倒三角背肌，针对男士的减肥药市场也在日益扩大。

en: I think whatever diet we follow or slimming products we indulge in, there is no magic trick to getting in shape for summer.
cn: 我认为，无论我们跟从何种节食方法，或是痴迷于何种瘦身产品，为迎接夏天而塑形终归是没有捷径可走的。

en: A balanced diet and moderate physical activity is still the best way, it seems to me.
cn: 均衡饮食，并结合适度的体力活动吧，对我来说，这似乎仍然是最好的方法。

en: Skin may seem like a superficial human attribute, but it's the first thing we notice about anyone we meet.
cn: 皮肤可能看似为人体表面特征，但却是我们与人相见时首先注意到的东西。

en: As a zoologist focusing on the studies of apes and monkeys, I've been studying why humans evolved to become the naked ape, and why skin comes in so many different shades around the world.
cn: 作为一名专注猿、猴研究的动物学家，我一直在研究人类为何进化成“裸猿”以及世界上为何有如此多种类的肤色。

en: We can make a very good estimate from the fossil record that humans probably evolved naked skin around a million and a half years ago, and meanwhile they mostly lost their coat of fur.
cn: 根据化石记录，我们可以非常合理地估计出，人类大约在150万年前就已进化出裸露肌肤，期间他们褪去了身上大部分体毛。

en: Today we have a few patches of hair remaining on various parts of our bodies, but compared with apes and monkeys, we have very little.
cn: 现在，我们身体的不同部位还残留着几块毛发，但与猿、猴相比，我们的毛发非常少。

en: Basically, we turned our skin darker to serve as a natural sun protector in the place of the hair we lost.
cn: 说到底，我们将皮肤变深是为了将其充作天然防晒品，以代替脱落的毛发。

en: We think we lost this hair because of the need to keep ourselves cool when we were moving around vigorously in a hot environment.
cn: 我们认为，我们脱落毛发是因为在炎热环境中来回用力走动时需要保持身体凉爽。

en: We can't really lose heat by breathing quickly and loudly like dogs.
cn: 我们无法像狗那样靠大声喘气来散热。

en: We have to do it by sweating.
cn: 我们必须通过流汗来散热。

en: So we evolved the ability to sweat plentifully and lost most of our fur.
cn: 所以，我们进化出大量排汗的能力，并且脱掉大部分皮毛。

en: Most animals protect themselves from the sun with fur.
cn: 大多数动物利用皮毛来让自己免受日晒。

en: What we did in our ancestry was to produce more permanent natural coloring in our skin cells.
cn: 我们祖先所做的是在皮肤细胞中生成更持久的天然色素。

en: This was really an important revolution in human history because it allowed us to continue to evolve in equatorial environments.
cn: 这的确是人类历史上一场重大革命，因为它使我们能够在赤道环境中继续进化。

en: It really made it possible for us to continue along the path toward modern humans in Africa.
cn: 它真的让我们得以继续沿着非洲现代人之路前进。

en: For most of human history we all had dark skin.
cn: 在人类历史长河中，我们的皮肤大多数时候是深色的。

en: What we see today is the product of evolutionary events resulting from the dispersal of a few human populations out of Africa around 60,000 to 70,000 years ago.
cn: 当前我们所看到的肤色状况是大约6~7万年前少数人群走出非洲所引发的进化事件的产物。

en: Our species originated around 200,000 years ago and underwent tremendous diversification—culturally, technologically, linguistically, artistically—for 130,000 years.
cn: 人类起源于大约20万年前，并经历了长达13万年的巨大差异化进程——文化、技术、语言及艺术上的。

en: After that, a few small populations left Africa to populate the rest of the world.
cn: 此后，少数人群离开非洲，移居世界各地。

en: These early ancestors of modern Eurasians dispersed into parts of the world that had more seasonal sunshine and much lower levels of sun radiation.
cn: 这些现代欧亚混血的早期祖先散居到世界其他区域，这些区域季节性日照更多、太阳辐射强度更低。

en: It's in these populations that we begin to see real changes in the genetic makeup of natural coloring.
cn: 正是在这些种群中我们开始看到天然色素基因组成的真正变化。

en: Today, skin color is evolving via new mixtures of people coming together and having children with new mixtures of skin color genes.
cn: 今天，新的混血儿联姻，再生出有着新的混合肤色基因的孩子，肤色就这么不断进化着。

en: We can see this in almost every large city worldwide.
cn: 这种情况我们几乎可以在世界上每座大城市看到。

en: Not only the coloring genes, but lots of other genes are getting mixed up, too.
cn: 不仅仅是肤色基因，还有很多其他基因也在混合。

en: Wow, I would give anything to be more like Audrey Hepburn.
cn: 哇，为了更像奥黛丽·赫本，我愿意付出所有。

en: I never really understood why so many girls were such big fans of her.
cn: 我从未真正搞懂过为什么这么多女孩都是她的铁杆粉丝。

en: I mean, I've seen the famous films, Roman Holiday, Breakfast at Tiffany's and a few others, but I still don't fully get it.
cn: 我的意思是，我看过她那些大名鼎鼎的电影：《罗马假日》《蒂凡尼的早餐》以及其他几部影片，但我始终没完全明白。

en: Was she that great of an actress?
cn: 她是这么棒的演员么？

en: Well, for me, my adoration goes beyond her movies.
cn: 嗯，对我来说，我对她的崇拜已经超乎电影之外。

en: She had such a classic elegance about her.
cn: 她有着如此典雅的气质。

en: She was always so poised, in part because she spent years training as a ballet dancer before becoming an actress.
cn: 她总是如此泰然自若，某种程度上是因为在成为演员之前，她接受过多年芭蕾舞训练。

en: Why didn't she stick to dancing as a career?
cn: 为什么她没有坚持舞蹈事业呢？

en: It seems it was fate.
cn: 似乎是命运的安排。

en: She suffered from inadequate nutrition during the war, and therefore, a career as a professional dancer would have been too demanding on her body.
cn: 战争时期她营养不良，专业舞者这一事业可能会令她身体吃不消。

en: So she focused on acting instead.
cn: 所以她转而专攻表演。

en: Roman Holiday was her first big break which made her a star.
cn: 《罗马假日》让她一炮而红，成了大明星。

en: Was that the film that opened with her shopping for jewelry in New York city?
cn: 就是那部以她在纽约购买珠宝开场的电影吗？

en: You know, the scene she was wearing a black dress and dark sunglasses with a pearl necklace and long black gloves.
cn: 你知道，就是那个穿着黑裙、戴着墨镜、珍珠项链和黑色长手套的场景。

en: I see the photo of her in that costume everywhere.
cn: 她身着那身行头的照片随处可见。

en: No, that one is Breakfast at Tiffany's.
cn: 不，那是《蒂凡尼的早餐》中的场景。

en: That costume is often referred to as the most famous little black dress of all time.
cn: 那个装束常被誉为有史以来最著名的小黑裙。

en: Her character in that film is very outgoing and charming, even though in real life, Audrey always described herself as shy and quiet.
cn: 奥黛丽在那部电影中饰演的角色活泼外向、十分迷人，即便在真实生活中她总是将自己描述为一个腼腆、安静的人。

en: So what did she do after her acting career?
cn: 那她在演艺生涯之后又做了什么呢？

en: She dedicated much of her life to helping children in need.
cn: 她将大部分精力投入到了帮助有需要的孩子中。

en: Her family received international aid during the war when she was growing up.
cn: 在她的成长过程中，她家在战争期间受到过国际援助。

en: I think that left a big impression on her.
cn: 我想这给她留下了深刻印象。

en: That's where I got the idea to volunteer for children's charity next weekend.
cn: 这使我萌生出下周去儿童慈善机构做志愿者的想法。

en: I'll join you.
cn: 我跟你一起去。

en: I may not be as charming as Audrey Hepburn, but I'm all for supporting a good cause.
cn: 我可能没奥黛丽·赫本那么有魅力，但我全力支持公益事业。

en: So, how is our presentation about the restructuring of the company coming along?
cn: 那么，咱们的公司整改相关汇报进展如何？

en: Fine.
cn: 挺好的。

en: I'm putting the finishing touches to it now.
cn: 我在做最后的润色。

en: But we'll have to be prepared for questions.
cn: 不过我们还得准备好应对大家的发问。

en: Yes, there's already a feeling that this is a top-down change.
cn: 是的，已经感觉到这是一次自上而下的变革了。

en: We really need to get everyone on board.
cn: 我们确实需要让所有人都参与进来。

en: Well, there's been an extensive consultation period.
cn: 嗯，已做过广泛磋商了。

en: I know, but there's always the feeling that if it isn't broke, don't fix it.
cn: 我明白，但总有人觉得，没坏的话就不要去修。

en: People are worried about their jobs, too.
cn: 大家也担忧自己的位子。

en: I think we need to stress that while there will be some job changes, there won't be anyone getting dismissed.
cn: 我觉得咱们得强调一下，虽然会有一些职位变动，但没人会被解雇。

en: In fact, we're looking to take on more staff.
cn: 事实上，我们还指望着招聘更多员工呢。

en: Agreed.
cn: 同意。

en: You can hardly blame people for worrying though.
cn: 但没法怪人们有这种担忧。

en: We need to make it clear that it's not just change for change's sake.
cn: 我们需要说清楚的是，不是为了变动而变动。

en: In other words, we really must make the case for why we are doing it.
cn: 换句话说，我们确实有必要说明为何要变革。

en: So what's the outline of the presentation?
cn: 那么，汇报的纲要是什么呢？

en: I'll start with a brief review of the reasons for the change that we really need to make a clean break to restart growth.
cn: 我会先简述变革的理由：为了重启增长，我们确实需要做个彻底的了断。

en: After that I'll outline the new company's structures and who's going where.
cn: 接着我会概述一下新公司的组织架构以及谁要调任到哪里。

en: Then I'll hand it over to you to discuss the timeline and summarize and we'll take questions together at the end.
cn: 然后我会把汇报交给你，讨论改革的时间表并做总结，最后我们一起回答问题。

en: Anything else?
cn: 你看还有要补充的吗？

en: Oh, yeah, we should let the staff know the channels of communication, you know, who they can contact or direct questions to about these changes.
cn: 噢，有，我们应该让员工们知道有哪些沟通渠道，你知道的，关于这些变动，他们可以联系谁，或将问题反映给谁。

en: Yes, and we can collect some frequently asked questions and present some general answers.
cn: 是的，并且我们可以收集些常见问题，给出大致的回答。

en: Um, and we'll make the presentation and the questions available via the company's own computer network, right?
cn: 嗯，还有，我们会通过公司自己的计算机网络让人们看到汇报和问题，对吧？

en: Yes, we'll make a page on the network where staff can download all the details.
cn: 是的，我们会在内网做个网页，员工可下载一切详情。

en: All right.
cn: 好的。

en: Perhaps we should do a practice run of the presentation first.
cn: 也许我们应该先做一轮汇报练习。

en: You bet.
cn: 一点没错。

en: Airline passengers have to deal with a lot these days, getting bumped from flights and losing luggage on top of the general anxiety that nervous passengers always feel.
cn: 如今的航空旅客必须应对许多问题，被拒绝登机、丢失行李，除此之外，神经紧张的乘客更是普遍总会感到焦虑。

en: At the Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport, miniature horses deliver a calming force two times a month.
cn: 在辛辛那提/北肯塔基国际机场，迷你马会每月两次为人们提供抚慰。

en: Denver and Ruby are two of the 34 therapy horses brought in from a local farm.
cn: 丹佛和鲁比是从当地一家农场培育的34匹治疗马中的两匹。

en: They can usually be found in the ticket counter area interacting with travelers.
cn: 它们通常会在售票区与旅客互动。

en: More than 30 airports across the country now have therapy dogs.
cn: 全美有30多个机场现已配备治疗犬。

en: San Francisco has a therapy pig.
cn: 旧金山有一头治疗猪。

en: San Jose, California, began a dog program after the terrorist attacks of September 11.
cn: 加州圣何塞在9·11恐怖袭击后开启了一项治疗犬计划。

en: Since its beginning, the program has now grown and has 21 therapy dogs and a therapy cat.
cn: 自启动至今，该计划已经发展壮大至拥有21只治疗犬和1只治疗猫。

en: The animals don't get startled.
cn: 这些动物不会受惊。

en: They have had hundreds of hours of airport training, so they are used to having luggage and people crowding around them.
cn: 它们已经接受过数百小时的机场训练，因此习惯了人和行李在它们身边挤来挤去。

en: These professional animals are probably better at finding their way in the airports than the most frequent of travelers.
cn: 这些受过专业训练的动物可能比出行最频繁的旅客还要善于机场认路。

en: The passengers often say that seeing animals makes them feel much better and helps them to calm down before a flight.
cn: 乘客常说看到动物会让他们感觉好很多，能帮他们在飞行前放松下来。

en: This little bit of support can sometimes make a big difference.
cn: 这点小小的支持有时会使得情形大为不同。

en: Some passengers enjoy the animals so much that they call the airport to schedule flights around their visits.
cn: 一些乘客非常喜欢这些动物，甚至会打电话给机场将自己的航班安排在它们的来访期。

en: Visits to nursing homes and schools are also part of the horses' regular schedule.
cn: 去养老院和学校提供类似治疗也属于这些马常规日程的一部分。

en: Their owner has begun developing a new line of therapy animals—donkeys.
cn: 他们的主人已经开始开发一种新的动物理疗师——驴。

en: Hello, viewers.
cn: 观众朋友们，大家好！

en: Today I'm standing at the 2000-year-old Roman-era site.
cn: 现在我正站在有着2000年历史的古罗马时期遗址上。

en: Here the brightly-colored scenes that once decorated a mansion are being dug up.
cn: 在这里，曾经用于装饰一所宅邸的多幅色彩亮丽的绘景即将出土。

en: These scenes are turning up in the southern French city of Arles, surprising the historians who have been working here since 2014.
cn: 自2014年以来，这些绘景在法国南部城市阿尔勒不断出现，令到这里进行研究的历史学家们惊奇不已。

en: Patches of paint still cling to the stone walls of the bedroom and reception hall.
cn: 一片一片的颜料仍然附着在卧室及接待大厅的石墙之上。

en: Some of these painted walls are preserved in places to a height of one meter.
cn: 有些壁画依然保留在离地一米高的地方。

en: In addition, thousands of fragments that fell off the walls have been recovered.
cn: 此外，从墙上剥落的不计其数的碎片也已被收回。

en: These pieces have been put back together with great care and display a variety of images.
cn: 这些碎片已经被悉心拼接复原，展示出各种图像。

en: Some of these images include figures never seen before in France, such as a woman playing a stringed instrument, possibly a character from mythology.
cn: 有些图像中的形象从未在法国出现过，比如弹奏弦乐器的女子，可能是来自神话的人物。

en: The paintings were done with such skill and with such expensive dyes that experts believe the artists originally came from Italy.
cn: 这些壁画的技巧极其精湛，使用的颜料非常昂贵，因此专家们认为这些画师最初来自意大利。

en: They were likely hired by one of the city's elite.
cn: 他们可能是被这座城里某位上层人士聘请而来。

en: Perhaps a Roman official wanted Pompeii-like interior to remind him of home.
cn: 或许是一名古罗马帝国官员想要庞贝风格的室内装潢，以让自己怀念故乡。

en: He was probably stationed in this provincial trading port founded in 46 B.C. as a colony for veterans of the Roman army.
cn: 这位官员可能是被安置到了这个外省贸易港口，该港口建立于公元前46年，是罗马帝国退伍军人的安置地。

en: Or maybe a wealthy local wanted to show off his worldly sophistication.
cn: 又或许是当地一名富人想要炫耀自己的老成练达、见多识广。

en: The paintings may yield even more stunning surprises as additional sections are put together, like pieces of a puzzle.
cn: 随着更多的碎片被像拼图一样拼接起来，壁画可能会带来更多的惊喜。

en: Whoever it was that created such magnificent pieces of art, they surely had no idea that their work would still be around thousands of years later.
cn: 无论当初是谁创作出了这些华丽的艺术品，他们都肯定不会想到自己的作品在数千年之后仍能得以留存。

en: Good afternoon, class.
cn: 同学们，下午好。

en: Today I want to discuss with you a new approach to empirical research.
cn: 今天我想和大家讨论一种新的实证研究方法。

en: In the past, scientists often worked alone.
cn: 过去，科学家们往往孤军奋战。

en: They were confined to the university or research center where they worked.
cn: 他们受禁锢于自己效力的大学或研究中心。

en: Today, though, we are seeing mergers of some of the greatest scientific minds, regardless of their location.
cn: 但如今，我们看到一些顶级科学家正在强强联合，而无论其地理位置如何。

en: There has never been a better time for collaborations with foreign scientists.
cn: 史上从未有过比现在更适合与外国科学家合作的时机。

en: In fact, the European Union is taking the lead.
cn: 事实上，欧盟正在带头领跑。

en: Spurred on by funding policies, half of European research articles had international co-authors in 2007.
cn: 在资助政策的刺激下，2007年，一半的欧洲研究论文有国际合著者。

en: This is more than twice the level of two decades ago.
cn: 这一比例是20年前的两倍多。

en: The European Union's level of international co-authorship is about twice that of the United States, Japan and India.
cn: 欧盟国际合著比例约为美国、日本和印度的两倍。

en: Even so, the levels in these countries are also rising.
cn: 即便如此，这些国家的国际合著比例也在升高。

en: This is a sign of the continued allure of creating scientific coalitions across borders.
cn: 这表明建立跨境科学联盟的持续吸引力。

en: Andrew Schubert, a researcher at the Institute for Science Policy Research, says that the rising collaboration is partly out of necessity.
cn: 科学政策研究所研究员安德鲁·舒伯特表示，这种合作的增加在一定程度上是出于必要。

en: This necessity comes with the rise of big science.
cn: 这种必要伴随大科学的兴起而生。

en: Many scientific endeavors have become more complicated.
cn: 许多科学工作变得越发复杂。

en: These new complications require the money and labor of many nations.
cn: 这些新的复杂情形要求多国投入金钱与人力。

en: But he says collaborations have also emerged because of increased possibilities.
cn: 但他指出，合作也因可能性的增加而出现。

en: The Internet allows like-minded scientists to find each other.
cn: 互联网使得志同道合的科学家找到彼此。

en: Simultaneously, dramatic drops in communication costs ease long-distance interactions.
cn: 同时，通讯费用的骤降使得远距离互动更加便利。

en: And there is a reward.
cn: 而且还能带来回报。

en: Studies of citation counts show that internationally co-authored papers have better visibility.
cn: 有关论文引用次数的研究表明，国际合著论文受关注程度更高。

en: Schubert says international collaboration is a way to spread ideas in wider and wider circles.
cn: 舒伯特称，国际合作是将理念传播到越来越广阔圈子的一种方式。

en: Caroline Wagner, a research scientist at George Washington University, notes that international collaborations offer additional flexibility.
cn: 乔治·华盛顿大学研究员卡洛琳·瓦格纳指出，国际合作提供了更多灵活性。

en: Whereas local collaborations sometimes persist past the point of usefulness because of social or academic obligations, international ones can be cultivated and dropped more freely.
cn: 本土合作有时即便已无所助益，也会因社会或学术义务而被迫维系，而国际合作的建立和终止更自由。

en: The collaborative trend is true across scientific disciplines.
cn: 这一合作趋势确实遍及各个科学领域。

en: Some fields, though, have a greater tendency for it.
cn: 不过，有些领域的这种趋势更强。

en: Particle physicists and astronomers collaborate often.
cn: 粒子物理学家及天文学家就经常合作。

en: This is because they must share expensive facilities.
cn: 这是因为他们得共享昂贵的设备。

en: Mathematics, by contrast, tend historically towards solitude.
cn: 相比之下，数学家历来倾向于独行。

en: As a consequence, they lag behind other disciplines.
cn: 因此，他们的国际合作落后于其他学科。

en: However, Wagner says partnerships are rising there, too.
cn: 然而，瓦格纳说，数学界的合作也在增加。

en: The level of collaboration also varies from country to country.
cn: 各国的合作比例也不尽相同。

en: There are historical and political reasons as to why collaborations emerge, says Wagner.
cn: 瓦格纳表示，合作的出现有其历史和政治原因。

en: This rise is also apparently boosted by policies embedded in European Framework funding schemes.
cn: 合作的增加也显然受到了嵌于欧洲资助计划框架的政策的推动。

en: These policies underlie funding requirements that often require teamwork.
cn: 资助条件以这些政策为依据，通常要求团队合作。

en: Good evening.
cn: 晚上好。

en: In 1959, on the day that I was born, a headline in Life magazine proclaimed "Target Venus: There May be Life There!"
cn: 1959年，在我出生那天，《生活》杂志上一则头版标题宣称：“瞄准金星；这里或许有生命存在！”

en: It told of how scientists rode a balloon to an altitude of 80,000 feet to make telescope observations of Venus's atmosphere, and how their discovery of water raised hopes that there could be living things there.
cn: 该篇文章讲述了科学家们如何乘气球升至8万英尺高空并借助望远镜对金星大气层展开观测，以及金星上水的发现如何唤起人们对“那里可能有生命存在”的期待。

en: As a kid, I thrilled to tales of adventure and Isaac Asimov's juvenile science-fiction novel Lucky Starr and the Oceans of Venus.
cn: 小时候，冒险故事和艾萨克·阿西莫夫的少年科幻小说《幸运的斯塔尔和金星上的海洋》都令我无比激动。

en: For many of my peers, though, Venus quickly lost its romance.
cn: 但对许多我的同龄人来说，金星很快就失去了传奇色彩。

en: The very first thing that scientists discovered with a mission to another planet was that Venus was not at all the Earthly paradise that fiction had portrayed.
cn: 执行另一颗行星探索任务的科学家们的首个发现便是：金星根本就不是小说里描绘的那片“人间”天堂。

en: It is nearly identical to our own planet in bulk properties such as mass, density, and size.
cn: 在质量、密度和大小等整体性质上，金星的确与我们的星球类似。

en: But its surface has been cooked and dried by an ocean of carbon dioxide.
cn: 但金星的表面已被二氧化碳海洋熘煮、烧干。

en: Trapped in the burning death-grip of a runaway greenhouse effect, Venus has long been held up as a cautionary tale for everything that could go wrong on a planet like Earth.
cn: 身陷失控温室效应所造成的灼热死亡牢笼，金星一直被当作警示教材，警醒人们在地球这类行星上可能会发生的任何糟糕的事。

en: As a possible home for alien life, it has been voted the planet least likely to succeed.
cn: 作为外星生命的可能家园之一，金星被评为最不可能成功孕育生命的星球。

en: But I have refused to give up on Venus, and over the years my stubborn loyalty has been justified.
cn: 但我拒绝放弃金星，而且这些年来我的忠诚不渝证明是对的。

en: The rocky views glimpsed by Venera 9 and other Russian landers suggested a tortured volcanic history.
cn: 金星9号及俄国的其它着陆器在金星上捕捉到了岩石景象，这表明金星在历史上曾饱受火山的折磨。

en: That was confirmed in the early 1990s by the American Magellan orbiter, which used radar to peer through the planet's thick clouds and map out a rich, varied, and dynamic surface.
cn: 20世纪90年代初，美国麦哲伦轨道器也证实了这一点，该轨道器利用雷达穿透金星稠密的云层，勾画出丰富多样且动态的金星表层。

en: The surface formed mostly in the last billion years, which makes it fresher and more recently active than any rocky planet other than Earth.
cn: 金星表层大部分形成于近十亿年，因此它比地球以外的任何岩态行星都年轻，近期也比它们更加活跃。

en: Russian and American spacecraft also found hints that its ancient climate might have been wetter, cooler, and possibly even friendly to life.
cn: 俄罗斯和美国的航天器亦发现“金星的远古气候或许比现在更加湿润凉爽，甚至可能利于生命存在”的迹象。

en: Measurements of density and composition imply that Venus originally formed out of basically the same stuff as Earth.
cn: 针对金星密度和组成成分的测量数据显示，金星最初的构成元素和地球基本相同。

en: That presumably included much more water than the tiny trace we find blowing in the thick air today.
cn: 这些元素包括了水，其总量想必远多于我们今天所发现的飘于金星浓密大气中的微量水汽。

en: Thus, our picture of Venus at around the time life was getting started on Earth is one of warm oceans, probably rich with organic molecules, splashing around rocky shores and volcanic vents.
cn: 所以，我们所构想的在地球上生命刚开始时的金星是一番温暖海洋的景象，海水很可能富含有机分子，海浪扑打在多岩的海岸和火山口上。

en: The sun was considerably less bright back then.
cn: 那时太阳远没有现在这么明亮。

en: So, Venus was arguably a cozier habitat for life than Earth.
cn: 所以可以说，当时的金星比地球还要更加宜居。

en: I'm a psychology professor at the University of British Columbia.
cn: 我是不列颠哥伦比亚大学的一名心理学教授。

en: I specialize in cultural psychology, examining similarities and differences between East Asians and North Americans.
cn: 我专门从事文化心理学研究，探究东亚人和北美人的异同。

en: Our research team has been looking at cultural differences in self-enhancing motivations, how people have positive feelings towards not only themselves, but things connected to themselves.
cn: 我们的研究团队一直在仔细研究自我提升动因方面的文化差异：人们如何以积极的态度看待自我以及那些与他们有联系的事物。

en: For example, when you own something, you view it as more valuable than when you don't own it.
cn: 比方说，一旦拥有某样东西，你会将它看得比没有这样东西时更有价值。

en: It's called the "endowment effect".
cn: 即所谓的“禀赋效应”。

en: The strength of that effect is stronger in Western cultures than in East Asian cultures.
cn: 该效应的效力在西方文化中比在东亚文化中更强。

en: So we've been looking at other ways of seeing whether this motivation to view oneself positively is shaped by cultural experiences.
cn: 因此我们一直在仔细考虑其他方法，来弄清积极看待自己的动因是否受文化经历的影响。

en: We've also started to look at how culture shapes sleep.
cn: 我们也开始仔细研究文化如何影响睡眠。

en: We are still in the exploratory stages of this project — although what's noteworthy is that East Asians on average sleep about an hour and a half less each night than North Americans do.
cn: 该项目当前仍处于探索阶段——尽管引人关注的是，东亚人每晚平均比北美人少睡约一个半小时。

en: And it's not a more efficient sleep, not like they're compressing relatively more value out of their hours.
cn: 而且睡眠也没有更高效，并不是说他们从时间里挤出了相对更多的价值。

en: Other studies have found that even infants in East Asia sleep about an hour less than European infants.
cn: 其他一些研究发现，甚至连东亚的婴儿都比欧洲的婴儿少睡约一个小时。

en: So we're trying to figure out how culture shapes the way you sleep.
cn: 所以我们正设法弄清文化如何影响我们的睡眠方式。

en: Our experiment does not take place in a sleep lab.
cn: 我们没在睡眠实验室中实验。

en: Instead, we lend people motion-detecting watches, and they wear them for a week at a time.
cn: 而是借给人们运动监测手表，并让他们连续佩戴一周。

en: Whenever they are not having a shower or swimming, they keep it on.
cn: 除洗澡或游泳外全程戴着手表。

en: These kinds of watches are used in sleep studies as a way of measuring how long people are sleeping, how efficient their sleep is, and whether they are waking up in the night.
cn: 睡眠研究将这种手表作为一种工具，测量人们睡了多久、睡眠效率如何，以及是否会在夜里醒来。

en: Ideally, I'd like to take this into a controlled lab environment.
cn: 理想来说，我想把这项研究放到可控的实验室环境下进行。

en: We'll see where the research points us.
cn: 我们要看看该研究领我们去向何方。

en: We usually start off with the more affordable methods and if everything looks promising, then it will justify trying to build a sleep lab and study sleep across cultures that way.
cn: 我们往往从负担得起的（研究）方法起步，要是前景看好，那么设法建立睡眠实验室并以这种方法来进行跨文化睡眠研究就证明是合理的了。

en: Why do we study sleep?
cn: 为何要研究睡眠呢？

en: Sleep is something that has really been an unexplored topic cross-culturally.
cn: 睡眠是一个从未真正在跨文化视角下探究过的话题。

en: I'm attracted to it because culture isn't something that only shapes the way our minds operate; it shapes the way our bodies operate too, and sleep is at the intersection of those.
cn: 我被它深深吸引，因为文化不仅影响我们思维运转的方式，它还会影响我们身体运转的方式，而睡眠正处在两者的交叉点。

en: Today our guest is Rosie Mullender, who works as Features Editor for Fashion magazine.
cn: 今天我们的嘉宾是罗茜·马伦德，她是《时尚》杂志的专栏编辑。

en: Hi, Rosie, you're Features Editor at one of the most widely-read women's magazines in the UK.
cn: 嗨，罗茜，你是英国读者最多的女性杂志之一的专栏编辑。

en: What kind of responsibilities does that job entail?
cn: 这份工作涉及哪些职责？

en: We spend our days looking at ideas from journalists, writing copy for the magazine and website, and editing.
cn: 我们每天的工作包括审阅记者的选题、为杂志和网站撰写文稿以及编辑。

en: We do random things like asking people in the street questions and testing sports clothing.
cn: 我们也会做一些随机的事情，比如在街上向人们提问和测试运动服装。

en: We also do less tangible things like understanding what our readers want.
cn: 我们还会做一些不那么具体的事情，比如了解读者的需求。

en: It's certainly varied and sometimes bizarre.
cn: 这确实多种多样，有时甚至有些奇怪。

en: During your working day, what kind of work might you typically do?
cn: 在您的工作日中，通常会做哪些工作？

en: My day mainly incorporates responding to emails, writing and editing stories and coming up with new feature ideas.
cn: 我的一天主要包括回复邮件、撰写和编辑报道，以及提出新的专题创意。

en: How does the job of Features Editor differ from that of Fashion Editor, or other editorial positions?
cn: 专栏编辑的工作与时尚编辑或其他编辑职位有何不同？

en: The features team deals with articles such as careers, reports, confidence and confessions—everything except fashion and beauty.
cn: 专栏团队处理的是关于职业、报道、自信和自白之类的文章——除了时尚和美容之外的所有内容。

en: A lot of people believe that working at a magazine is a glamorous job.
cn: 很多人认为在杂志社工作是一份光鲜亮丽的工作。

en: Is this an accurate representation of what you do?
cn: 这准确描述了您的工作吗？

en: I'd say it's glamorous to an extent, but not in the way it's portrayed in films.
cn: 我会说它在某种程度上是光鲜的，但并不像电影里描绘的那样。

en: We do have our moments, such as interviewing celebrities and attending parties, which is a huge thrill.
cn: 我们确实有高光时刻，比如采访名人和参加派对，这非常刺激。

en: Ultimately, though, we're the same as our readers, but working in a job we're all very lucky to have.
cn: 不过归根结底，我们和读者一样，只是从事着一份我们都很幸运拥有的工作。

en: Did you have to overcome any difficulties to reach this point in your career?
cn: 您在职业生涯中走到这一步，是否克服了某些困难？

en: How did you manage to do this?
cn: 您是如何做到的？

en: I had to be really persistent and it was very hard work.
cn: 我必须非常坚持，而且工作非常辛苦。

en: After three years of working in a petrol station and doing unpaid work, I still hadn't managed to get an entry-level job.
cn: 在加油站工作了三年并做一些无薪工作之后，我仍然没能找到一份入门级的工作。

en: I was lucky that my last desperate attempt led to a job.
cn: 幸运的是，我最后一次拼命的尝试带来了一份工作。

en: I told myself that all experiences make you a better journalist in the long run—and luckily, I was right!
cn: 我告诉自己，从长远来看，所有经历都会让你成为更好的记者——幸运的是，我是对的！

en: Are you watching any good shows these days?
cn: 你最近在看什么好节目吗？

en: Actually, yes.
cn: 实际上，有的。

en: I'm watching a great satire called Frankie.
cn: 我正在看一部很棒的讽刺剧，叫《弗兰基》。

en: I think you'd like it.
cn: 我想你会喜欢的。

en: Really? What's it about?
cn: 真的吗？它是关于什么的？

en: It's about a real guy named Frankie.
cn: 它是关于一个叫弗兰基的真实人物。

en: He is a famous comedian in New York and the show's a mixture of comedy and drama loosely depicting his life.
cn: 他是纽约的著名喜剧演员，这部剧是喜剧和戏剧的混合体，粗略地描绘了他的生活。

en: I'm sorry, do you mean to say, it's a real-life series about a real person?
cn: 抱歉，你的意思是说，这是一部关于真人的真实生活剧集？

en: It's non-fiction, is it?
cn: 它是非虚构的，对吗？

en: No...Not really, no.
cn: 不……不完全是，不是。

en: It's fiction, as what happens in every episode is made up.
cn: 它是虚构的，因为每一集发生的事情都是编造的。

en: However the lead role is a comedian by the name of Frankie, and he plays himself.
cn: 不过主角是一位名叫弗兰基的喜剧演员，他扮演自己。

en: So Frankie in both real life and in the TV show lives in New York City, is a comic, is divorced, and has two little daughters.
cn: 所以弗兰基在现实生活和电视剧中都住在纽约市，是一位喜剧演员，离异，有两个小女儿。

en: All those things are true, but aside from him, all his friends and family are played by actors.
cn: 这些都是真的，但除了他之外，他所有的朋友和家人都是由演员扮演的。

en: And the plots and events that take place are also invented.
cn: 而且发生的情节和事件也是虚构的。

en: Oh, I think I see now.
cn: 哦，我想我现在明白了。

en: That sounds like a very original concept.
cn: 这听起来是一个非常新颖的概念。

en: Yes, it is.
cn: 是的，确实如此。

en: In fact, the whole show is written, directed, edited and produced by him, and is very funny and has won many awards.
cn: 事实上，整部剧都是由他编写、导演、剪辑和制作的，非常有趣，而且赢得了许多奖项。

en: That's cool.
cn: 太酷了。

en: I will try to download it.
cn: 我会试着下载它。

en: I'm watching a comedy called The Big Bang Theory.
cn: 我正在看一部叫《生活大爆炸》的喜剧。

en: It's a huge hit around the world.
cn: 它在全球都很受欢迎。

en: Oh yes. I've heard of it, but never actually watched it.
cn: 哦，是的。我听说过，但从未真正看过。

en: Well, then you should check it out.
cn: 嗯，那你应该去看看。

en: It's also very funny.
cn: 它也非常有趣。

en: It's about four male scientists and a female waitress.
cn: 它是关于四个男科学家和一个女服务员的。

en: The men are very socially awkward but very bright.
cn: 这些男士在社交上非常笨拙，但非常聪明。

en: And this is contrasted by the lady's social skills and common sense.
cn: 这与女士的社交技能和常识形成对比。

en: The show has been running for over ten years, and some of the actors are practically global super stars, now that they are such famous celebrities.
cn: 这部剧已经播了十多年，其中一些演员实际上已是全球超级巨星，因为他们都是如此著名的名人。

en: Related to the “use it or lose it” law is the “keep moving” principle.
cn: 与“用进废退”法则相关的是“永不止步”原则。

en: We learned about stagnation from nature.
cn: 我们从大自然中了解到停滞。

en: A river that stops moving gets smelly.
cn: 停止流动的河流会变臭。

en: The same thing happens to people who stop moving, either mentally or physically.
cn: 同样的事情也发生在那些停止活动的人身上，无论是精神上还是身体上。

en: Those who play contact sports know that the player who usually gets hurt the most is the one who is standing still.
cn: 从事身体接触运动的人都知道，通常受伤最重的运动员是站着不动的那个。

en: Of course, you'll need some time to catch your breath every so often, but the essential message is “keep moving, extending and learning”.
cn: 当然，你需要时不时地喘口气，但核心信息是“保持运动、拓展和学习”。

en: Ships last a lot longer when they go to sea than when they stay in the harbor.
cn: 船只出海航行比停泊在港口里更耐用。

en: The same is true for airplanes.
cn: 飞机也是如此。

en: You don't preserve an airplane by keeping it on the ground.
cn: 你不会通过让飞机停在地上来保养它。

en: You preserve it by keeping it in service.
cn: 你通过让它保持运行来保养它。

en: We also get to live a long healthy life by staying in service.
cn: 我们也可以通过保持活跃来健康长寿。

en: Longevity statistics reveal that the average person doesn't last very long after retirement.
cn: 长寿统计数据显示，普通人在退休后活不了太久。

en: The moral here is don't retire.
cn: 这里的启示是不要退休。

en: If a fellow says “I'm 94 years old and I worked all my life”, we need to realize, that is how he got to be 94, by staying involved.
cn: 如果有人说“我94岁了，我工作了一辈子”，我们需要认识到，他正是通过保持参与才活到94岁的。

en: In 2014, one in 16 Americans visited the hospital emergency room for home injuries.
cn: 2014年，每16个美国人中就有1人因家庭伤害去医院急诊室。

en: One of the main causes of these accidents? A wandering mind.
cn: 这些事故的主要原因之一？走神。

en: By one estimate, people daydream through nearly half of their waking hours.
cn: 据估计，人们醒着的时候有近一半时间在做白日梦。

en: Psychologists have recently focused on the tendency to think about something other than the task one is doing.
cn: 心理学家最近开始关注人们在执行任务时思考其他事情的倾向。

en: For one experiment, researchers developed an app to analyze the relationship between daydreaming and happiness.
cn: 在一项实验中，研究人员开发了一款应用程序来分析做白日梦与幸福感之间的关系。

en: They found that the average person's mind wandered most frequently (about 65% of the time) during personal activities, such as brushing their teeth and combing their hair.
cn: 他们发现，普通人在个人活动（如刷牙和梳头）期间走神最频繁（约65%的时间）。

en: Respondents' minds tended to wander more when they felt upset rather than happy.
cn: 受访者在感到沮丧而非快乐时，思绪更容易走神。

en: They were more likely to wander toward pleasant topics than unpleasant ones.
cn: 他们更可能转向愉快的话题，而非不愉快的话题。

en: How do daydreams affect daydreamers?
cn: 白日梦如何影响做白日梦的人？

en: A wandering mind leaves us vulnerable when driving.
cn: 开车时走神会让我们变得脆弱。

en: In one study, researchers interviewed 955 people involved in traffic accidents.
cn: 在一项研究中，研究人员采访了955名交通事故涉及者。

en: The majority of them reported having daydreamed just before the accident.
cn: 他们中的大多数报告在事故发生前曾做白日梦。

en: Yet other research suggests that daydreaming has benefits.
cn: 然而，其他研究表明白日梦有好处。

en: Researchers have found that it gives us a chance to think about our goals and it also seems to increase creativity.
cn: 研究人员发现，它给我们一个思考目标的机会，而且似乎还能提高创造力。

en: In one experiment, 145 undergraduates completed four “unusual uses” tasks, each requiring them to list as many uses as possible for an everyday object.
cn: 在一项实验中，145名本科生完成了四项“非常规用途”任务，每项任务都要求他们尽可能多地列出日常物品的用途。

en: After the first pair of tasks was completed, one group of participants was assigned an undemanding activity intended to cause their minds to wander.
cn: 在第一组任务完成后，一组参与者被分配了一项轻松的活动，旨在让他们的思绪走神。

en: When all the participants proceeded to the second pair of tasks, the daydreamers performed 40 percent better than the others.
cn: 当所有参与者进行第二组任务时，做白日梦的人的表现比其他组好40%。

en: Dating from as far back as the 12th century, they are claimed to be the rarest historic buildings in western Europe.
cn: 它们的历史可追溯到12世纪，据称是西欧最罕见的历史建筑。

en: These buildings offer vital insight into Scandinavia's Viking past.
cn: 这些建筑为了解斯堪的纳维亚的维京历史提供了重要视角。

en: But now, with only 30 wooden churches remaining and their condition deteriorating, experts are working to preserve the structures for future generations.
cn: 但现在，仅存30座木制教堂且状况日益恶化，专家们正在努力为后代保护这些建筑。

en: Some of these spectacular churches are no more than small buildings, barely 4 metres wide and 6 metres tall.
cn: 这些壮观的教堂中，有些不过是小型建筑，宽仅4米，高6米。

en: Others are much larger structures.
cn: 其他的则要大得多。

en: They soar up to 40 metres into the cold air.
cn: 它们高耸入寒空，达40米。

en: Most consist of timber frames that rest on stone blocks.
cn: 大多数由木框架构成，架在石块上。

en: This means that they have no foundations.
cn: 这意味着它们没有地基。

en: Although many of the churches appear from the outside to be complex structures, they normally feature only a single storey but numerous different roof levels.
cn: 尽管许多教堂从外面看结构复杂，但它们通常只有一层，但有很多不同的屋顶层次。

en: Staff from the Norwegian government have carried out conservation work on 10 of the churches over the past two years.
cn: 挪威政府的工作人员在过去两年中对其中10座教堂进行了保护工作。

en: Most of these churches date from between the 12th and 14th centuries.
cn: 这些教堂大多建于12至14世纪之间。

en: Other churches were conserved in previous years.
cn: 其他教堂在前几年已得到保护。

en: So far, specialists have worked to add preservative materials to the churches' exteriors.
cn: 到目前为止，专家们已经为教堂外部添加了防腐材料。

en: They also replaced rotting roofs and halted the sinking of the churches into the ground.
cn: 他们还更换了腐烂的屋顶，并阻止了教堂下陷。

en: In two cases, huge machines have been used to lift the buildings up to 30 centimetres into the air.
cn: 在两个案例中，使用了大型机器将建筑抬升了30厘米。

en: This was accomplished so that the team could examine and repair the churches' original medieval stone blocks.
cn: 这样做是为了让团队能够检查和修复教堂原有的中世纪石块。

en: The team plans to return to around a dozen of the buildings to assess progress and consider further action.
cn: 该团队计划返回大约十几座建筑，评估进展并考虑进一步行动。

en: The earliest free-standing wooden church was probably built in Norway in around 1080.
cn: 最早的独立式木制教堂可能建于1080年左右的挪威。

en: However, the largest known wooden churches were built from the 1130s onwards.
cn: 然而，已知最大的木制教堂建于1130年代以后。

en: This period was one of inter-elite rivalry in which nobles sought to increase their influence by funding the construction of churches and other buildings.
cn: 这一时期是精英阶层相互竞争的时期，贵族通过资助教堂和其他建筑的建设来扩大影响力。

en: The reason for constructing the buildings from wood is probably that ideally proportioned straight and slender timber was available in large quantities in Scandinavia's vast pine forests.
cn: 用木材建造这些建筑的原因，可能是因为斯堪的纳维亚广阔的松林中有大量比例匀称、笔直细长的木材。

en: As wood was so plentiful, it was cheaper to use than the stone used in the buildings of other European cultures.
cn: 由于木材非常丰富，它比其他欧洲文化建筑中使用的石材更便宜。

en: The area's ship-building tradition, partly established by the Vikings, also meant that sophisticated carpentry was a major aspect of the local culture.
cn: 该地区部分由维京人建立的造船传统，也意味着精湛的木工技艺是当地文化的一个重要方面。

en: The complex style of the medieval wooden church carvings, and the skills used to make them, almost certainly derive from the ancient Viking tradition.
cn: 中世纪木制教堂雕刻的复杂风格以及制作它们的技术，几乎肯定源自古老的维京传统。

en: In last week's lecture, we discussed the characteristics of the newly born offspring of several mammals.
cn: 在上周的课上，我们讨论了几种哺乳动物新生后代的特点。

en: You probably remember that human infants are less developed physically than other mammals of the same age.
cn: 你们可能还记得，人类婴儿在身体发育上不如同龄的其他哺乳动物。

en: But in today's lecture, we'll look at three very interesting studies that hint at the surprising abilities of human babies.
cn: 但在今天的课上，我们将看三项非常有趣的研究，它们暗示了人类婴儿令人惊讶的能力。

en: In the first study, three-year-olds watched two videos shown side by side, each featuring a different researcher, one of whom they'd met once two years earlier.
cn: 在第一项研究中，三岁儿童观看并排播放的两个视频，每个视频中出现不同的研究员，其中一位他们在两年前见过一次。

en: The children spent longer watching the video showing the researcher they hadn't met.
cn: 孩子们花更长时间观看显示他们没见过的研究员的那段视频。

en: This is consistent with young children's usual tendency to look longer at things that aren't familiar.
cn: 这与幼儿通常倾向于更长时间注视不熟悉事物的情况一致。

en: And really this is amazing.
cn: 这真的很惊人。

en: It suggests the children remembered the researcher they'd met just one time when they were only one-year-olds.
cn: 这表明孩子们记得他们在仅一岁时只见过一次的研究员。

en: Of course, as most of us forget memories from our first few years as we grow older, these early long-term memories will likely be lost in subsequent years.
cn: 当然，随着我们长大，大多数人会忘记生命最初几年的记忆，这些早期的长期记忆很可能在随后的岁月中丢失。

en: Our second study is about music.
cn: 我们的第二项研究是关于音乐的。

en: For this study, researchers played music to babies through speakers located on either side of a human face.
cn: 在这项研究中，研究人员通过位于人脸两侧的扬声器向婴儿播放音乐。

en: They waited until the babies got bored and averted their gaze from the face.
cn: 他们等到婴儿感到无聊并移开注视人脸的视线。

en: And then they changed the mood of the music, either from sad to happy or the other way around.
cn: 然后他们改变了音乐的情绪，要么从悲伤变为欢快，要么相反。

en: This mood switch made no difference to the three-month-olds; but for the nine-month-olds, it was enough to renew their interest and they started looking again in the direction of the face.
cn: 这种情绪转换对三个月大的婴儿没有影响；但对九个月大的婴儿来说，这足以重新激发他们的兴趣，他们又开始看向人脸的方向。

en: This suggests that babies of that age can tell the difference between a happy melody and a sad tune.
cn: 这表明那个年龄的婴儿能够区分欢快和悲伤的曲调。

en: Our final study is from 1980, but it's still relevant today.
cn: 我们的最后一项研究来自1980年，但今天仍然具有现实意义。

en: In fact, it's one of the most famous pieces of research about infant emotion ever published.
cn: 事实上，这是有史以来发表的关于婴儿情绪的最著名的研究之一。

en: The study involved ordinary adults watching video clips of babies nine months or younger.
cn: 该研究让普通成年人观看九个月或更小婴儿的视频片段。

en: In the video clips, the babies made various facial expressions in response to real-life events including playful interactions and painful ones.
cn: 在视频片段中，婴儿对现实生活中的事件（包括嬉戏互动和疼痛事件）做出各种面部表情。

en: The adult observers were able to reliably discern an assortment of emotions on the babies' faces.
cn: 成年观察者能够可靠地辨别婴儿脸上的各种情绪。

en: These emotions included interest, joy, surprise, sadness, anger, disgust, contempt, and fear.
cn: 这些情绪包括兴趣、快乐、惊讶、悲伤、愤怒、厌恶、轻蔑和恐惧。

en: Next week, we'll be looking at this last study more closely.
cn: 下周，我们将更仔细地探讨这最后一项研究。

en: In fact, we will be viewing some of the video clips from that study.
cn: 事实上，我们将观看那项研究中的一些视频片段。

en: And together, see how well we do in discerning the babies' emotions.
cn: 并一起看看我们在辨别婴儿情绪方面表现如何。

en: Today I'd like to talk about the dangers of being too collaborative.
cn: 今天我想谈谈过度合作的危害。

en: Being a good team player is an essential skill in our modern workplace.
cn: 做一个好的团队合作者是我们现代职场中的一项基本技能。

en: The ability to work well with others and collaborate on projects is a sought-after ability in nearly every position.
cn: 与他人良好合作并在项目上协作的能力几乎是每个职位都渴求的能力。

en: However, placing too much emphasis on being a good team player can negatively affect your career growth.
cn: 然而，过分强调做一个好的团队合作者会对你的职业发展产生负面影响。

en: Don't be overly focused on gaining consensus.
cn: 不要过于关注达成共识。

en: Don't be too concerned with the opinions of others.
cn: 不要太在意别人的意见。

en: This can hinder your ability to make decisions, speak up, and gain recognition for your individual skills and strengths.
cn: 这会阻碍你做出决定、畅所欲言以及因个人技能和优势获得认可的能力。

en: Some people are too subordinate to others' opinions, too focused on decision consensus, too silent about their own point of view, too agreeable to take things on when they don't have time or energy.
cn: 有些人过于顺从别人的意见，过于注重决策共识，对自己的观点过于沉默，在没有时间或精力时过于随和地承担事情。

en: This leads to building a brand of underconfident, submissive, low-impact non-leaders and hammers their growth and career advancement.
cn: 这会导致形成一种缺乏自信、顺从、影响力低的非领导者形象，并损害他们的成长和职业晋升。

en: Collaboration certainly makes your individual competencies and contributions more difficult for outsiders to identify.
cn: 合作当然会让外人更难识别你的个人能力和贡献。

en: Collaborative projects mean you're sharing the spotlight with others.
cn: 合作项目意味着你与他人共享聚光灯。

en: Outsiders may then find it difficult to determine your contributions and strengths.
cn: 外人可能因此难以确定你的贡献和优势。

en: This may end up costing you opportunities for promotions or pay raises.
cn: 这最终可能会让你失去晋升或加薪的机会。

en: You certainly shouldn't ditch teamwork, but how can you avoid the hazards of being an over-collaborator?
cn: 你当然不应该放弃团队合作，但如何避免过度合作的风险呢？

en: Working in a team can have huge benefits.
cn: 在团队中工作可以带来巨大的好处。

en: Your team may have repeated successes and often gain recognition.
cn: 你的团队可能会不断取得成功并经常获得认可。

en: You then have more opportunities to expand your professional network than if you worked alone.
cn: 那么你比独自工作时有更多机会拓展你的职业关系网。

en: However, finding a balance between team efforts and individual projects that give you independent recognition is important for making a name for yourself and providing opportunities for advancement.
cn: 然而，在团队努力和能给你带来独立认可的个人项目之间找到平衡，对于为自己扬名和提供晋升机会很重要。

en: Be selective in who you work with.
cn: 在选择合作对象时要有所选择。

en: This will maximize the benefits and minimize the downsides of being a team player.
cn: 这将最大化收益，并最小化作为团队合作者的缺点。

en: Collaborate with people who have complementary expertise.
cn: 与具有互补专业知识的人合作。

en: Select projects where there's potential for mutual benefit.
cn: 选择具有互利潜力的项目。

en: Perhaps you're bringing your unique knowledge and gaining access to someone else's professional network.
cn: 也许你带来了自己的独特知识，并获得了进入他人职业关系网的机会。

en: Or maybe you're able to learn a new skill by working with someone.
cn: 或者你可以通过与某人一起工作来学习新技能。

en: Seek out your teammates purposefully rather than jumping on every new group project opportunity.
cn: 有目的地寻找队友，而不是抓住每一个新的团队项目机会。

en: When we're too collaborative, we want everyone to agree with a decision before we proceed.
cn: 当我们过于合作时，我们希望每个人在行动之前都同意某个决定。

en: This can create unnecessary delays as you hold meetings trying to achieve a consensus.
cn: 这会造成不必要的延误，因为你开会试图达成共识。

en: It's fine to be collaborative when seeking input, but put a deadline on the input stage and arrive at a decision, even if it's a decision that doesn't have consensus.
cn: 在征求建议时合作是可以的，但要在征求意见阶段设定截止日期并做出决定，即使这个决定没有达成共识。

en: Excuse me, where is your rock music section?
cn: 打扰一下，你们的摇滚乐区在哪里？

en: Rock music? I'm sorry, we're a jazz store.
cn: 摇滚乐？抱歉，我们是一家爵士乐商店。

en: We don't have any rock and roll.
cn: 我们没有摇滚乐。

en: Oh, you only have jazz music? Nothing else?
cn: 哦，你们只有爵士乐？没有别的？

en: That's right.
cn: 没错。

en: We're the only record store in London dedicated exclusively to jazz.
cn: 我们是伦敦唯一一家专营爵士乐的唱片店。

en: Actually, we're more than just a record store.
cn: 实际上，我们不仅仅是一家唱片店。

en: We have a café & library upstairs and a ticket office down the hall, where you can buy tickets to all the major jazz concerts in the city.
cn: 我们楼上有咖啡馆和图书馆，大厅尽头有售票处，可以买到本市所有主要爵士音乐会的门票。

en: Also, we have our own studio next door, where we produce albums for up-and-coming artists.
cn: 另外，我们隔壁有自己的录音室，为崭露头角的艺术家制作专辑。

en: We are committed to fostering new music talent.
cn: 我们致力于培养新的音乐人才。

en: Wow! That's so cool.
cn: 哇！太酷了。

en: I guess there's not much of a jazz scene anymore, not like they used to be.
cn: 我猜现在爵士乐的氛围不多了，不像过去那样。

en: But here you're trying to promote this great music genre.
cn: 但你们在这里努力推广这种伟大的音乐类型。

en: Yes, indeed.
cn: 是的，确实。

en: Nowadays, most people like to listen to pop and rock music.
cn: 如今，大多数人喜欢听流行和摇滚音乐。

en: Hip hop music from America is also getting more and more popular.
cn: 来自美国的嘻哈音乐也越来越受欢迎。

en: So as a result, there are fewer listeners of jazz, which is a great shame because it's an incredibly rich genre.
cn: 因此，爵士乐的听众更少了，这非常可惜，因为它是一种极其丰富的音乐类型。

en: But that's not to say there isn't any good new jazz music being made out there anymore far from it.
cn: 但这并不是说现在没有好的新爵士乐作品了——远非如此。

en: It's just a much smaller market today.
cn: 只是今天的市场小得多。

en: So how would you define jazz?
cn: 那么你会如何定义爵士乐？

en: Well, interestingly enough, there's no agreed-upon definition of jazz.
cn: 嗯，有趣的是，爵士乐没有统一的定义。

en: Indeed, there are many different styles of jazz.
cn: 事实上，爵士乐有许多不同的风格。

en: Some have singing, but most don't.
cn: 有些带人声，但大多数没有。

en: Some are electric and some aren't.
cn: 有些是电声的，有些不是。

en: Some contain live experimentation, but not always.
cn: 有些包含现场实验，但并非总是如此。

en: While there's no simple definition for it, and while there are many different styles of jazz, you simply know it when you hear it.
cn: 虽然爵士乐没有简单的定义，虽然有很多不同的风格，但你一听就能认出来。

en: Honestly, the only way to know what jazz is, is listen to it yourself.
cn: 老实说，了解爵士乐的唯一方式就是亲自去听。

en: As the great trumpet player, Louis Armstrong said, if you gotta ask, you'll never know.
cn: 正如伟大的小号手路易斯·阿姆斯特朗所说，如果你非要问，那你永远不会知道。

en: How did it go at the bank this morning?
cn: 今天早上去银行办得怎么样？

en: Not well, my proposal was rejected.
cn: 不顺利，我的申请被拒绝了。

en: Really? But why?
cn: 真的吗？为什么？

en: Bunch of reasons.
cn: 一大堆原因。

en: For starters, they said my credit history was not good enough.
cn: 首先，他们说我的信用记录不够好。

en: Did they say how you could improve that?
cn: 他们有没有说你怎么能改善？

en: Yes, they said that after five more years of paying my mortgage, then I would become a more viable candidate for a business loan.
cn: 有，他们说再还五年按揭贷款后，我就会成为更符合商业贷款条件的候选人。

en: But right now, it's too risky for them to lend me money.
cn: 但现在，他们借钱给我风险太大。

en: They fear I will default on any business loan I'm given.
cn: 他们担心我会拖欠任何给我的商业贷款。

en: Well, that doesn't sound fair.
cn: 嗯，这听起来不公平。

en: Your business idea is amazing.
cn: 你的商业创意很棒。

en: Did you show them your business plan? What did they say?
cn: 你有没有给他们看你的商业计划书？他们怎么说？

en: They didn't really articulate any position regarding the actual business plan.
cn: 他们并没有对实际的商业计划书明确表态。

en: They simply looked at my credit history and determined it was not good enough.
cn: 他们只是看了我的信用记录，然后认定它不够好。

en: They said the bank has strict guidelines and requirements as to who they can lend money to.
cn: 他们说银行对贷款对象有严格的指导方针和要求。

en: And I simply don't meet their financial threshold.
cn: 而我根本达不到他们的财务门槛。

en: What if you ask for a smaller amount?
cn: 如果你申请更少的金额呢？

en: Maybe you could gather capital from other sources.
cn: 也许你可以从其他渠道筹集资金。

en: Smaller loans from more lenders?
cn: 从更多贷款机构获得小额贷款？

en: You don't get it.
cn: 你不明白。

en: It doesn't matter the size of the loan I ask for, or the type of business I propose.
cn: 我申请的贷款金额大小或我提议的业务类型都不重要。

en: That's all inconsequential.
cn: 这些都无关紧要。

en: The first thing every bank will do is study how much money I have and how much debt I have before they decide whether or not to lend me any more money.
cn: 每家银行在决定是否再借钱给我之前，首先要做的就是研究我有多少钱和多少债务。

en: If I want to continue ahead with this dream of owning my own business, I have no other choice but to build up my own finances.
cn: 如果我想继续追求自己创业的梦想，我别无选择，只能改善自己的财务状况。

en: I need around 20% more in personal savings and 50% less debt.
cn: 我需要个人储蓄增加约20%，债务减少50%。

en: That's all there is to it.
cn: 就这么简单。

en: I see now.
cn: 我现在明白了。

en: Well, it's a huge pity that they rejected your request, but don't lose hope.
cn: 嗯，他们拒绝了你的申请真是太遗憾了，但别灰心。

en: I still think that your idea is great and that you would turn it into a phenomenal success.
cn: 我仍然认为你的想法很棒，而且你会把它变成巨大的成功。

en: There's a lot about Leo Sanchez and his farm in Salinas, California that seems unusual.
cn: 里欧·桑切斯和他位于加州萨利纳斯的农场有很多不寻常之处。

en: The national average farm size is around 440 acres, but his is only one acre.
cn: 全国平均农场面积约为440英亩，但他的只有一英亩。

en: The average age of farmers hovers around 58 years old, but he is just 26.
cn: 农民的平均年龄在58岁左右，但他只有26岁。

en: And Sanchez constantly attempts to improve everything from seeding techniques out in the field to the promotion and sale of his produce online.
cn: 桑切斯不断尝试改进一切，从田间的播种技术到在线推广和销售他的农产品。

en: This is evidence of an experimental approach.
cn: 这是实验性方法的证据。

en: It's an approach not dictated by the confines of conventional, large-scale agriculture led by international corporations.
cn: 这种方法不受跨国公司主导的传统大规模农业的限制。

en: While farming is often difficult for both the body and mind, Sanchez says he and many of his fellow young farmers are motivated by desire to set a new standard for agriculture.
cn: 虽然务农常常身心俱疲，但桑切斯表示，他和许多年轻的同行们是受到设立农业新标准的愿望的激励。

en: Many of them are employing a multitude of technologies, some new and some not so new.
cn: 他们中的许多人正在使用多种技术，有些是新的，有些则不那么新。

en: Recently, Sanchez bought a hand-operated tool which pulls out weeds and loosens soil.
cn: 最近，桑切斯买了一个手动工具，可以拔草和松土。

en: It actually dates back to at least 1701.
cn: 它实际上至少可以追溯到1701年。

en: It stands in sharp contrast to Sanchez's other gadget, a gas-powered flame weedkiller invented in 1997.
cn: 这与桑切斯的另一件小工具——1997年发明的燃气火焰除草机——形成鲜明对比。

en: He simply doesn't discriminate when it comes to the newness of tools.
cn: 在工具的新旧方面，他完全不区分。

en: If it works, it works.
cn: 只要有用，就行。

en: Farmers have a long history of invention, and it's no different today.
cn: 农民有悠久的发明历史，今天也不例外。

en: Young farmers are guided by their love for agriculture and aided by their knowledge of technology.
cn: 年轻农民以对农业的热爱为指导，以技术知识为辅助。

en: To find inexpensive and appropriately sized tools, they collaborate and innovate.
cn: 为了找到价格低廉且尺寸合适的工具，他们合作并创新。

en: Sometimes the old stuff just works better or more efficiently.
cn: 有时旧的东西效果更好或效率更高。

en: Eat Grub is Britain's first new food company that breaks western food boundaries by introducing edible insects as a new source of food.
cn: Eat Grub是英国第一家通过引入可食用昆虫作为新食物来源来打破西方食物界限的新型食品公司。

en: And Sainsbury's is the first UK supermarket to stock the company's crunchy roasted crickets.
cn: Sainsbury's是英国第一家上架该公司香脆烤蟋蟀的超市。

en: Sainsbury's insists that such food is no joke and could be a new, sustainable source of protein.
cn: Sainsbury's坚称这种食物不是玩笑，可能是一种新的、可持续的蛋白质来源。

en: Out of curiosity, I paid a visit to Sainsbury's.
cn: 出于好奇，我去了Sainsbury's。

en: As I put my hand into a packet of crickets with their tiny eyes and legs, the idea of one going in my mouth made me feel a little sick.
cn: 当我把手伸进一包有细小眼睛和腿的蟋蟀时，想到有一只放进我嘴里，让我觉得有点恶心。

en: But the first bite was a pleasant surprise.
cn: 但第一口咬下去却是一个惊喜。

en: A little dry and lacking of taste, but at least a wing didn't get stuck in my throat.
cn: 有点干，没什么味道，但至少没有翅膀卡在喉咙里。

en: The roasted seasoning largely overpowered any other flavour, although there was slightly bitter aftertaste.
cn: 烤过的调味料基本盖过了其他任何味道，虽然有一点苦味余韵。

en: The texture was crunchy, but smelt a little of cat food.
cn: 口感酥脆，但闻起来有点像猫粮。

en: Eat Grub also recommends the crickets as a topping for noodles, soups and salads.
cn: Eat Grub还推荐将蟋蟀用作面条、汤和沙拉的配料。

en: The company boasts that its dried crickets contain more protein than beef, chicken and pork, as well as minerals like iron and calcium.
cn: 该公司宣称其蟋蟀干含有比牛肉、鸡肉和猪肉更多的蛋白质，以及铁和钙等矿物质。

en: Unlike the production of meat, bugs do not use up large amounts of land, water or feed.
cn: 与肉类生产不同，昆虫不会消耗大量的土地、水或饲料。

en: And insect farming also produces far fewer greenhouse gases.
cn: 而且昆虫养殖产生的温室气体也少得多。

en: However, despite 2 billion people worldwide already supplementing their diet with insects, "consumer disgust" remains a large barrier in many Western countries.
cn: 然而，尽管全球已有20亿人将昆虫作为饮食补充，但在许多西方国家，“消费者的厌恶”仍然是一个很大的障碍。

en: I'm not sure bugs will become a popular snack any time soon, but they're definitely food for thought.
cn: 我不确定昆虫很快会成为流行零食，但它们绝对是发人深省的东西。

en: Have you ever had someone try to explain something to you a dozen times with no luck—but, then, when you see a picture, the idea finally clicks?
cn: 你有没有遇到过这种情况：有人试图向你解释某件事十几次都不成功——但当你看到一张图片时，你突然就明白了？

en: If that sounds familiar, maybe you might consider yourself a visual learner.
cn: 如果这听起来很熟悉，也许你会认为自己是一个视觉学习者。

en: Or if reading or listening does the trick, maybe you feel like you're a verbal learner.
cn: 或者如果阅读或聆听更有效，也许你觉得自己是一个言语学习者。

en: We call these labels learning styles, but is there really a way to categorize different types of students?
cn: 我们称这些标签为学习风格，但真的有办法对不同类型的学生进行分类吗？

en: Well, it actually seems that multiple presentation formats, especially if one of them is visual, help most people learn.
cn: 嗯，实际上，多种呈现形式——尤其是其中一种是视觉形式——似乎能帮助大多数人学习。

en: When psychologists and educators test for learning styles, they're trying to figure out whether these are inherent traits that affect how well students learn, instead of just a preference.
cn: 当心理学家和教育学家检验学习风格时，他们试图弄清这些是否是影响学生学习效果的固有特征，而不仅仅是一种偏好。

en: Usually they start by giving a survey to figure out what style a student favors, like visual or verbal learning.
cn: 通常他们先做问卷调查，弄清学生偏好哪种风格，比如视觉学习还是言语学习。

en: Then, they try to teach the students something with a specific presentation style, like using visual aids, and do a follow-up test to see how much they learned.
cn: 然后，他们尝试用特定的呈现方式（比如使用视觉教具）教学生一些东西，并进行后续测试，看看他们学了多少。

en: That way, the researchers can see if the self-identified verbal learners really learned better when the information was just spoken aloud, for example.
cn: 这样一来，研究人员就可以看看，例如，那些自认为是言语学习者的学生在信息被大声说出时是否真的学得更好。

en: But, according to a 2008 review, only one study that followed this design found that students actually learned best with their preferred style.
cn: 但是，根据2008年的一篇综述，只有一项遵循这种设计的研究发现，学生实际上用他们偏好的风格学得最好。

en: But the study had some big flaws.
cn: 但这项研究有一些重大缺陷。

en: The researchers excluded two-thirds of the original participants because they didn't seem to have any clear learning style from the survey at the beginning.
cn: 研究人员排除了三分之二的原始参与者，因为他们在最初的调查中似乎没有任何明确的学习风格。

en: And, they didn't even report the actual test scores in the final paper.
cn: 而且，他们甚至在最终论文中没有报告实际测试分数。

en: So it doesn't really seem like learning styles are an inherent trait that we all have.
cn: 所以学习风格似乎并不是我们都有的固有特征。

en: But, that doesn't mean that all students will do amazingly if they just spend all their time reading from a textbook.
cn: 但是，这并不意味着如果所有学生把所有时间都花在阅读教科书上，他们就会表现出色。

en: Instead, most people seem to learn better if they're taught in several ways—especially if one is visual.
cn: 相反，如果通过多种方式教学——尤其是其中一种是视觉方式——大多数人似乎学得更好。

en: In one study, researchers tested whether students remembered lists of words better if they heard them, saw them, or both.
cn: 在一项研究中，研究人员测试了学生是否在听到、看到或两者兼有的情况下能更好地记住单词列表。

en: And everyone seemed to do better if they got to see the words in print, even the self-identified auditory learners.
cn: 而且，如果能看到印刷出来的单词，每个人似乎都做得更好，即使是那些自认为听觉型的学习者。

en: Their preference didn't seem to matter.
cn: 他们的偏好似乎无关紧要。

en: Similar studies tested whether students learned basic physics and chemistry concepts better by reading plain text or viewing pictures, too.
cn: 类似的研究也测试了学生通过阅读纯文本还是观看图片能更好地学习基础物理和化学概念。

en: And everyone did better with the help of pictures.
cn: 而且在图片的帮助下，每个人都学得更好。

en: Free market capitalism hasn't freed us; it has trapped us.
cn: 自由市场资本主义没有解放我们；它困住了我们。

en: It's imperative for us to embrace a workplace revolution.
cn: 我们必须拥抱一场职场革命。

en: We are unlikely to spend our last moments regretting that we didn't spend enough of our lives slaving away at work.
cn: 我们不太可能在临终时后悔没有把足够多的生命花在拼命工作上。

en: We may instead find ourselves feeling guilty about the time we didn't spend watching our children grow, or with our loved ones, or travelling, or on the cultural or leisure pursuits that bring us happiness.
cn: 我们反而可能会因为没有花时间看着孩子成长、陪伴爱人、旅行或从事带给我们快乐的文化或休闲活动而感到内疚。

en: Unfortunately, the average full-time employee in the world works 42 hours a week, well over a third of the time we're awake.
cn: 不幸的是，世界上平均全职员工每周工作42小时，远远超过我们清醒时间的三分之一。

en: Some of our all too precious time is being stolen.
cn: 我们一些极其宝贵的时间正在被偷走。

en: Office workers do around two billion hours of unpaid overtime each year.
cn: 办公室职员每年大约有20亿小时的无偿加班。

en: So it's extremely welcome that some government coalitions have started looking into potentially cutting the working week to four days.
cn: 因此，一些政府联盟开始研究将每周工作时间缩短至四天的可能性，这是非常受欢迎的。

en: The champions of free market capitalism promised their way of life would bring us freedom.
cn: 自由市场资本主义的倡导者承诺他们的生活方式会带给我们自由。

en: But it wasn't freedom at all: from the lack of secure, affordable housing to growing job insecurity and rising personal debt, the individual is trapped.
cn: 但这根本不是自由：从缺乏安全、负担得起的住房，到日益增长的就业不安全和不断上升的个人债务，个人陷入了困境。

en: Nine decades ago, leading economists predicted that technological advances and rising productivity would mean that we'd be working a 15-hour week by now: that target has been somewhat missed.
cn: 九十年前，杰出的经济学家预测，技术进步和生产力的提高将意味着我们现在每周只需工作15小时：这个目标多少有些落空了。

en: Here is the most malignant threat to our personal freedom, particularly as the balance of power in the workplace has been shifted so dramatically from worker to boss.
cn: 这是对我们个人自由最恶毒的威胁，尤其是当职场权力的天平已经如此戏剧性地从工人转向老板时。

en: A huge portion of our lives involves the surrender of our freedom and personal autonomy.
cn: 我们生命中的很大一部分涉及放弃我们的自由和个人自主权。

en: It's time in which we are directed by the needs and desires of others, and denied the right to make our own choices.
cn: 这段时间里，我们被他人的需求和欲望所支配，并被剥夺了自主选择的权利。

en: That's bad for us: it's hardly surprising that over half a million workers suffer from work-related mental health conditions each year, or that 15.4 million working days were lost to work-related stress last year, a jump of nearly a quarter.
cn: 这对我们不利：每年有超过50万工人患有与工作相关的心理健康问题，或者去年因工作压力损失了1540万个工作日（增加了近四分之一），这并不令人惊讶。

en: Yes, there are those who, far from being overworked, actually seek more hours.
cn: 是的，有些人非但没有过度劳累，反而希望更多工作时间。

en: But a shorter working week would enable us to redistribute hours from the overworked to the underworked.
cn: 但缩短工作周将使我们能够将工作时间从过度劳累者重新分配给工作不足者。

en: We need to look at ways of cutting the working week without slashing living standards: after all, the world's workers have already suffered the worst deduction in wages since the early 1800s.
cn: 我们需要寻找在不降低生活水平的情况下缩短工作周的方法：毕竟，世界工人已经遭受了自19世纪初以来最严重的工资削减。

en: And cutting the working week would be conducive to the individual, giving millions of workers more time to spend as they see fit.
cn: 缩短工作周对个人有利，让数百万工人有更多时间按照他们认为合适的方式度过。

en: Today I'm going to talk about Germany's dream airport in Berlin.
cn: 今天我要谈谈柏林的梦想机场。

en: The airport looks exactly like every other major modern airport in Europe, except for one big problem: more than seven years after it was originally supposed to open, it still stands empty.
cn: 这个机场看起来和欧洲其他主要现代机场一模一样，除了一个大问题：原定开放时间已经过去了七年多，它仍然空置着。

en: Germany is known for its efficiency and refined engineering, but when it comes to its new ghost airport, this reputation could not be further from the truth.
cn: 德国以效率和精湛的工程技术闻名，但说到它的新幽灵机场，这种声誉与事实相去甚远。

en: Plagued by long delays, perpetual mismanagement and ever-soaring costs, the airport has become something of a joke among Germans—and a source of frustration for local politicians, business leaders and residents alike.
cn: 由于长期延误、长期管理不善和不断飙升的成本，这个机场已经成为德国人眼中的笑柄——也是当地政客、商界领袖和居民沮丧的根源。

en: Planning for the new airport began in 1989.
cn: 新机场的规划始于1989年。

en: At the time, it became clear that the newly-reunified Berlin would need a modern airport with far greater capacity than its existing airports.
cn: 当时，人们清楚地认识到，重新统一后的柏林需要一个比现有机场容量大得多的现代化机场。

en: The city broke ground on the new airport in 2006.
cn: 该市于2006年为新机场破土动工。

en: The first major sign of problems came in summer 2010, when the construction corporation pushed the opening from October 2011 to June 2012.
cn: 问题的第一个重大迹象出现在2010年夏天，当时建筑公司将开放时间从2011年10月推迟到2012年6月。

en: In 2012, the city planned an opening ceremony.
cn: 2012年，该市计划举行开幕仪式。

en: But less than a month beforehand, inspectors found significant problems with the fire safety system and pushed the opening back again to 2013.
cn: 但不到一个月前，检查人员发现消防安全系统存在重大问题，并将开放时间再次推迟到2013年。

en: It wasn't just the smoke system: many other major problems subsequently emerged.
cn: 不仅仅是烟雾系统：随后又出现了许多其他重大问题。

en: More than 90 metres of cable were incorrectly installed; 4,000 doors were wrongly numbered; escalators were too short.
cn: 超过90米长的电缆安装不正确；4000扇门编号错误；自动扶梯太短。

en: And there was a shortage of check-in desks.
cn: 而且值机柜台不足。

en: So why, with so many problems discovered, didn't the airport corporation decide to give up on the project and start over?
cn: 那么，为什么发现了这么多问题，机场公司却没有决定放弃这个项目并重新开始呢？

en: The reason is simple: people are often hesitant to terminate a project when they've already invested time or resources into it, even if it might make logical sense to do so.
cn: 原因很简单：人们往往不愿意放弃一个已经投入了时间或资源的项目，即使这样做在逻辑上是合理的。

en: The longer the delays continued, the more problems inspectors found.
cn: 延误持续得越久，检查人员发现的问题就越多。

en: Leadership of the planning corporation has changed hands nearly as many times as the opening date has been pushed back.
cn: 规划公司的领导层更换的次数几乎和开放日期被推迟的次数一样多。

en: Initially, rather than appointing a general contractor to run the project, the corporation decided to manage it themselves despite lack of experience with an undertaking of that scale.
cn: 最初，公司没有任命总承包商来管理项目，而是决定自己管理，尽管缺乏处理如此规模项目的经验。

en: To compound the delays, the unused airport is resulting in massive costs.
cn: 更糟糕的是，未使用的机场导致了巨大的成本。

en: Every month it remains unopened costs between €9m and €10m.
cn: 它每月未开放的成本在900万至1000万欧元之间。

en: Assuming all goes well, the airport should open in October 2020.
cn: 假设一切顺利，机场应在2020年10月开放。

en: But the still-empty airport stands as the biggest embarrassment to Germany's reputation for efficiency—and a continuing drain on city and state resources.
cn: 但这个仍然空置的机场是德国效率声誉的最大尴尬——也是城市和州资源的持续消耗。

en: Tonight, we have a very special guest.
cn: 今晚我们有一位特别来宾。

en: Mrs Anna Sanchez is a three- time Olympic champion and author of the new book To the Edge.
cn: 安娜·桑切斯女士三度获得奥运冠军，新近还写了本书，名叫《挑战极限》。

en: Mrs Sanchez, thank you for joining us.
cn: 桑切斯女士，感谢参加我们的节目。

en: Thank you for having me.
cn: 感谢你们的邀请。

en: Let's start with your book.
cn: 我们先从您的这本书聊起吧。

en: What does the title To the Edge mean?
cn: 《挑战极限》这个书名是什么意思？

en: What are you referring to?
cn: 您指什么？

en: The book is about how science and technology has helped push humans to the edge of their physical abilities.
cn: 这本书主要探讨科学与技术如何助推人类迫近体能极限。

en: I argue that in the past 20 years we've had the best athletes the world has ever seen.
cn: 我认为，在过去二十年里，我们培养出了人类历史上最优秀的运动员。

en: But is this a fair comparison?
cn: 但这样比较合适吗？

en: How do you know, how, say, a football player from 50 years ago would compare to one today?
cn: 你怎么知道，比方说，如何能将五十年前的足球运动员和现如今的足球运动员相提并论呢？

en: Well, you are right.
cn: 嗯，你说得有道理。

en: That comparison would be perhaps impossible to make.
cn: 这样比较或许不可取。

en: But the point is more about our knowledge today of human biochemistry, nutrition and mechanics.
cn: 但关键更在于我们现如今对于人体生化、营养及力学的了解。

en: I believe that while our bodies have not changed in thousands of years, what has changed is the scientific knowledge.
cn: 我认为，人类身体几千年来都未曾改变，改变的是科学知识。

en: This has allowed athletes to push the limits of what was previously thought possible.
cn: 多亏这一点，运动员才得以突破先前所认定的极限。

en: That's interesting.
cn: 真有趣。

en: Please tell us more about these perceived limits.
cn: 请跟我们多谈谈人们所认定的极限吧。

en: The world has seen sports records being broken that could only be broken with the aid of technology, whether this be the speed of a tennis serve or the fastest time in a 100- meter dash or 200- meter swimming race.
cn: 人类世界已见证了借助科技才得以被打破的体育记录，无论是网球的发球速度，还是100米短跑、200米游泳比赛的最短用时，都是如此。

en: Is there any concern that technology is giving some athletes an unfair advantage over others?
cn: 会不会担忧技术给某些运动员带来不公平的优势？

en: That is an interesting question and one that has to be considered very carefully.
cn: 这是一个很有意思的问题，也是一个必须慎重考虑的问题。

en: Skis, for example, went from being made of wood to a metal alloy, which allows for better control and faster speed.
cn: 举个例子，滑雪板从木制过渡到金属合金制，以便实现更好的控制与更快的速度。

en: There is no stopping technological progress.
cn: 技术进步之势不可阻挡。

en: But, as I said, each situation should be considered carefully on a case- by- case basis.
cn: 但是，正如我所说，每种情形都应该慎重考虑，具体问题具体分析。

en: I've worked in international trade all my life.
cn: 我在外贸行业干了一辈子。

en: My father did so too before me.
cn: 在我之前，我父亲也是这样。

en: So I guess you could say it runs in the family.
cn: 所以我觉得你大可说这是代代相传。

en: What products have you worked with?
cn: 你经手过哪些产品？

en: All sorts, really.
cn: 不夸张地说，什么都有。

en: I've imported textiles, machinery, toys, solar panels, all kinds of things over the years.
cn: 这些年来我进口过纺织品、机器、玩具、太阳能电池板，各种各样的东西。

en: Trends and demand come and go.
cn: 趋势和需求变化不断。

en: So one needs to be very flexible to succeed in this industry.
cn: 所以要想在这个行业中取得成功，就必须非常灵活变通。

en: I see.
cn: 我明白。

en: What goods are you trading now?
cn: 那你现在在做什么生意呢？

en: I now import furniture from China into Italy and foods from Italy into China.
cn: 我现在把家具从中国进口到意大利，把食品从意大利进口到中国。

en: I even use the same container.
cn: 我甚至连集装箱都用同一个。

en: It's a very efficient way of conducting trade.
cn: 这样处理生意的效率很高。

en: The same container?
cn: 同一个集装箱？

en: You mean you own a 40- foot cargo container?
cn: 你是说你有一个40英尺集装箱？

en: Yeah, that's right.
cn: 对，没错。

en: I have a warehouse in Genova, Italy and another in Shanghai.
cn: 我在意大利热那亚有一个仓库，上海也有一个。

en: I source mid- century modern furniture from different factories in China.
cn: 我从中国的各个工厂搜寻中世纪摩登风格家具。

en: It's very good value for money.
cn: 它们很划算。

en: I collect it all in my warehouse and then dispatch it to my other warehouse in Italy.
cn: 我把它们全都集中到我的仓库，然后运到我在意大利的另一个仓库。

en: Over there I do the same, but with Italian foods instead of furniture, things like pasta, cheese, wine, chocolates.
cn: 在那边我也是这么做，只不过家具换成了意大利食品，比如意大利面、奶酪、红酒和巧克力。

en: And I send all that to my warehouse in China in the same freight container I use for the furniture.
cn: 我把所有这些都运到中国的仓库，用的还是我用来运家具的货物集装箱。

en: So I presume you sell both lines of products wholesale in each respective country.
cn: 我猜你的两大产品系列在两个国家都是批发出售的。

en: Of course.
cn: 当然了。

en: I possess a network of clients and partners in both countries.
cn: 我在两个国家都有客户和伙伴关系网。

en: That's the main benefit of having done this for so long.
cn: 这就是在这个行业干了这么久的最大好处。

en: I've made great business contacts over time.
cn: 我积累了不少生意熟人。

en: How many times do you ship?
cn: 你会运多少批货物？

en: I did 12 shipments last year.
cn: 我去年运了12批。

en: 18 this year, and I hope to grow to around 25 next year.
cn: 今年运了18批，希望明年能增到差不多25批。

en: That's both ways, there and back again.
cn: 这是算上来回两条路线的。

en: Demand for authentic Italian food in China is growing rapidly.
cn: 中国对正宗意大利食品的需求正在快速增长。

en: And similarly, sales of affordable, yet stylish wooden furniture are also increasing in Italy.
cn: 同样地，价格不算贵但样式雅致的木制家具在意大利也卖得越来越好。

en: Furniture is marginally more profitable, mostly because it enjoys lower customs duties.
cn: 家具盈利稍微多些，主要是因为它享有较低的关税。

en: "Too many people view their jobs as a five- day prison from which they are paroled every Friday," says Joel Goodman, founder of the Humour Project, a humour consulting group in Saratoga Springs, New York.
cn: '太多人将工作视为五日监禁，每周五被假释出狱。' '幽默计划'（一家位于纽约萨拉托加斯普林斯的幽默咨询集团）的创始人乔尔·古德曼如是说。

en: Humour unlocks the office prison because it lets adults bring some of their childlike spirit to the job.
cn: 幽默打开了办公室这座监狱之门，因为它让成年人将自己孩童般的活力带到工作中。

en: According to Howard Pollio, professor of psychology at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, an office with humour breaks is an office with satisfied and productive employees.
cn: 田纳西大学诺克斯维尔分校的心理学教授霍华德·波利奥认为，一间能够提供幽默小憩时光的办公室会是一间内部员工心满意足、工作高效的办公室。

en: Pollio conducted a study that proved humour can help workers excel at routine production tasks.
cn: 波利奥开展的一项研究证明，幽默能帮助员工出色地完成日常工作任务。

en: Employees perform better when they have fun.
cn: 当员工们开心时，他们的表现会更好。

en: In large corporations with a hierarchy of power, there is often no outlet for stress.
cn: 在权力等级森严的大公司里，员工往往没有释放压力的出口。

en: "Every company needs underground ways of poking fun at the organization," says Lynn N. Mark, a speaker on workplace humour for St. Mary's Health Centre in St. Louis.
cn: 圣路易斯圣玛丽健康中心的职场幽默演讲者琳恩·N·马克说：'每个公司都要有进行自我调侃的私密途径。'

en: Kodak's Rochester, New York branch discovered a way for its 20,000 employees to uncork their bottled- up resentments.
cn: 柯达纽约罗彻斯特分公司为其2万名员工找到了一种发泄内心积怒的办法。

en: Their 1,000- square- foot Humour Room features a toy store.
cn: 他们的幽默室占地面积1000平方英尺，玩具店是其主要特色。

en: Among the room's many stress- reducing gadgets, the main attraction is a boss doll with detachable arms and legs.
cn: 室内有众多减压小器械，其中最引人注目的是一个胳膊和腿都可以拆卸的老板娃娃。

en: Employees can take the doll apart as long as they put its arms and legs back in place.
cn: 员工们能将该老板娃娃拆解（以泄愤），只要他们之后将其胳膊和腿复位。

en: Sandy Cohen, owner of a graphic print production business, created the Quote Board to document the bizarre phrases people say when under strict deadlines.
cn: 某平面印刷制作公司的老板桑迪·科恩创建了一个'引用板'，用来记录人们在严苛任务期限下所说的怪诞话语。

en: "When you're under stress, you say stupid things," says Cohen.
cn: '压力之下，你会说一些愚蠢的话。'科恩说。

en: "Now we just look at each other and say, that's one for the Quote Board."
cn: '现在，我们只是互相看着对方说，这话是说给'引用板'的。'

en: Public interest was aroused by the latest discovery of a changed gene in obese mice.
cn: 最近在肥胖小鼠身上发现的一种变异基因引起了公众关注。

en: The news was made known by Rockefeller University geneticist Jeffrey Friedman.
cn: 该消息由洛克菲勒大学遗传学家杰弗里·弗里德曼公布。

en: The researchers believe this gene influences development of a hormone that tells the organism how fat or full it is.
cn: 研究人员认为，该基因会影响某种能让机体感知自身胖瘦或饱腹程度的激素的分泌。

en: Those with the changed gene may not sense when they have eaten enough or if they have sufficient fatty tissue, and thus can't tell when to stop eating.
cn: 那些发生基因变异的小鼠可能感知不到自己什么时候吃饱或者是否已拥有足够的脂肪组织，因此也就无法判断该什么时候停止进食。

en: The researchers also reported finding a gene nearly identical to the mouse obesity gene in humans.
cn: 研究人员还报告指出，他们在人体中发现了一种与小鼠肥胖基因几乎完全相同的基因。

en: The operation of this gene in humans has not yet been demonstrated, however.
cn: 但该基因在人体内的作用尚未被证实。

en: Still, professionals like University of Vermont psychologist Esther Rothblum reacted enthusiastically: "This research indicates that people really are born with a tendency to have a certain weight, just as they are to have a particular skin color or height."
cn: 尽管如此，像佛蒙特大学心理学家埃丝特·罗思布鲁姆这样的专业人士表现出了极大兴趣：'这项研究表明，人确实生来就倾向于有特定的体重，就像有某种特定的肤色或身高一样。'

en: Actually, behavioral geneticists believe that less than half of the total weight variation is programmed in the genes, while height is almost entirely genetically determined.
cn: 实际上，行为遗传学家认为，身高几乎完全由基因决定，而体重差异只有不到一半写在基因里。

en: Whatever role genes play, Americans are getting fatter.
cn: 不管基因扮演什么样的角色，美国人都在变胖。

en: A survey by the Center for Disease Control found that obesity has increased greatly over the last 10 years.
cn: 疾病控制中心的一项调查发现，过去十年间，肥胖症显著增加。

en: Such rapid change underlines the role of environmental factors, like the abundance of rich foods, in Americans' overeating.
cn: 如此迅速的变化凸显了环境因素（如大量油腻食物）对美国人过量饮食的影响。

en: The Center for Disease Control has also found that teens are far less physically active than they were even a decade ago.
cn: 疾病控制中心还发现，即使与十年前相比，青少年参加的体育锻炼也大大减少。

en: Accepting that weight is predetermined can relieve guilt for overweight people.
cn: 对超重人士来说，接受'体重是预先确定好的'能减轻其负罪感。

en: But people's belief that they cannot control their weight can itself contribute to obesity.
cn: 但'人无法控制自己的体重'这一想法本身亦是导致肥胖的原因。

en: Qualities of a relationship, such as openness, compassion, and mental stimulation are of concern to most of us regardless of sex, but—judging from the questionnaire response—they are more important to women than to men.
cn: 一段关系的品质，诸如坦率、同情、精神激励，对我们大多数人而言都至关重要，无关乎性别。但是，从问卷调查结果来看，女性比男性更看重这些品质。

en: Asked to consider the ingredients of close friendship, women rated these qualities above all others.
cn: 当被要求评估亲密友谊的要素时，女性把这些品质列于其他一切品质之上。

en: Men assigned a lower priority to them in favor of similarity in interests, selected by 77% of men, and responsiveness in a crisis, chosen by 61% of male respondents.
cn: 男性则将这些品质排得较低，他们更看重的是：兴趣相似性（被77%的男性受访者选择）以及危机响应力（被61%的男性受访者选择）。

en: Mental stimulation, ranked third in popularity by men as well as women, was the only area of overlap.
cn: 精神激励在男性和女性群体中均排名第三，这是唯一重叠的区域。

en: Among men, only 28% named openness as an important quality; caring was picked by just 23%.
cn: 男性中，只有28%的受访者认为坦率是重要的品质；为他人着想则仅被23%的受访者选择。

en: It is evident by their selections that when women speak of close friendships they are referring to emotional factors, while men emphasize the pleasure they find in a friend's company.
cn: 他们的选择表明，当女性言及亲密友谊时，指的是情感因素，而男性则强调他们与友为伴时所获得的乐趣。

en: That is, when a man speaks of 'a friend' he is likely to be talking about someone he does things with—a teammate, a fellow hobbyist, a drinking buddy.
cn: 也就是说，当男性说到'朋友'时，可能指的是与他一起做事的人——队友、兴趣相投者、酒友。

en: These activities are the fabric of the friendship; it is a 'doing' relationship in which similarity in interests is the key bond.
cn: 这些活动是友谊的基本架构；这是一种'共事'的友谊，兴趣相似性是维持友谊的关键纽带。

en: This factor was a consideration of less than 11% of women.
cn: 而考虑这一因素的女性占比却不到11%。

en: Women opt for a warm, emotional atmosphere where communication flows freely; activity is mere background.
cn: 她们选择的是可以畅所欲言的温暖、感性氛围，活动（对她们而言）纯属虚设。

en: Lastly, men, as we have seen, have serious questions about each other's loyalty.
cn: 最后，正如我们看到的，男性对彼此的忠诚抱有很大的疑问。

en: Perhaps this is why they placed such strong emphasis on responsiveness in a crisis—'someone I can call on for help.'
cn: 也许，这正是他们如此强调危机响应力的原因——'某个我能寻求帮助的人'。

en: Women, as their testimonies indicate, are generally more secure with each other and consequently are more likely to treat this issue lightly.
cn: 而正如其选择所表明的，女性通常对彼此更有安全感，因此也更可能轻松面对危机。

en: In follow- up interviews this was confirmed numerous times as woman after woman indicated that 'being there when needed was taken for granted.'
cn: 在后续采访中，这一点得到多次证实，一位又一位女性表示：'在需要时出现是理所当然的。'

en: As for the hazards of friendship, more than a few relationships have been shattered because of cutthroat competition and feelings of betrayal.
cn: 至于友谊的威胁，不少友谊因为激烈的竞争和感受到背叛而瓦解。

en: This applies to both men and women, but unequally.
cn: 这在男性和女性身上都有发生，但是程度不同。

en: In comparison, nearly twice as many men complained about these issues as women.
cn: 相比之下，抱怨这些问题的男性几乎是女性的两倍。

en: Further, while competition and betrayal are the main thorns to female friendship, men are plagued in almost equal amounts by two additional issues: lack of frankness and a fear of appearing unmanly.
cn: 此外，竞争和背叛是女性友谊的主要威胁，而男性的友谊还受到其他两个因素几乎同样程度的困扰：不够坦率、担心显得没有男子气概。

en: Obviously, for a man, a good friendship is hard to find.
cn: 很明显，对男性来说，挚友难寻。

en: The partial skeletons of more than 20 dinosaurs and the scattered bones of about 300 more have been discovered in Utah and Colorado at what is now the Dinosaur National Monument.
cn: 在犹他州和科罗拉多州现在是美国国立恐龙公园的地方已经发现了20多只恐龙的局部骨架和300多只恐龙的零散骨骼。

en: Many of the best specimens may be seen today at museums of natural history in the larger cities of the United States and Canada.
cn: 其中许多最好的标本如今或许能在美国和加拿大较大城市的自然历史博物馆里看到。

en: This dinosaur pit is the largest and best preserved deposit of dinosaurs known today.
cn: 这个恐龙坑是目前已知规模最大、保存最为完好的恐龙化石埋藏地。

en: Many people get the idea from the mass of bones in the pit wall that some disaster such as a volcanic explosion or a sudden flood killed a whole herd of dinosaurs in this area.
cn: 许多人看到坑壁中的大量骨头会产生一种观点：火山爆发或洪水突发等某种灾难导致了这一地区整个恐龙的灭亡。

en: This could have happened but it probably did not.
cn: 这种事或许发生过，但也很可能并没有发生。

en: The main reasons for thinking otherwise are the scattered bones and the thickness of the deposit.
cn: 认为并非如此的主要理由在于骨骼的零散程度以及埋藏层的厚度。

en: In other deposits where the animals were thought to have died together, the skeletons were usually complete and often all the bones were in their proper places.
cn: 在其他被认作动物集群死亡的埋藏地，骨架通常完整无缺，且往往所有骨头各居其位。

en: Rounded pieces of fossil bone have been found here.
cn: 而在此埋藏地中发现了圆形的骨骼化石碎片。

en: These fragments got their smooth round shape by rolling along the stream bottom.
cn: 这些碎片是因为沿河底滚动而变成了光滑的圆形物。

en: In a mass killing, the bones would have been left on the stream or lake bottom together at the same level.
cn: 动物大规模死亡时，骨头会一起被留在河底或湖底的同一水平面。

en: But in this deposit, the bones occur throughout a zone of sandstone about 12 feet thick.
cn: 但在此埋藏地，骨头在12英尺厚的砂岩层中均有分布。

en: The mixture of swamp dwellers and dry- land types also seems to indicate that the deposit is a mixture from different places.
cn: 沼泽栖息类恐龙和陆地生活类恐龙混杂的情形似乎也表明这一埋藏地的恐龙遗骸来自不同地方。

en: The pit area is a large dinosaur graveyard, not a place where they died.
cn: 这一坑区是一个巨大的恐龙埋葬地，而非它们的死亡地。

en: Most of the remains probably floated down an eastward flowing river until they were left on a shallow sandbar.
cn: 大部分遗骸可能是随东流的河水漂流而下，最后被留在了一个浅滩沙洲之上。

en: Some of them may have come from far- away dry- land areas to the west.
cn: 其中有些可能来自遥远的西部陆地。

en: Perhaps they drowned trying to cross a small stream or were washed away during floods.
cn: 这些恐龙或许是死在尝试横穿小河时溺亡，或许是在洪水爆发时被冲走。

en: Some of the swamp dwellers may have got stuck in the very sandbar that became their grave; others may have floated for miles before being stranded.
cn: 一些沼泽栖息类恐龙可能正好被围死在了那个成为其坟墓的沙洲；另一些沼泽栖息类恐龙则可能在搁浅之前已经漂流数英里。

en: Even today similar events take place.
cn: 即便今天，类似的情况也仍在发生。

en: When floods come in the spring, sheep, cattle and deer are often trapped by rising waters and often drown.
cn: 当春天洪水来临时，羊、牛、鹿经常被上涨的河水所困住、并常常溺亡。

en: Their dead bodies float downstream until the flood recedes and leaves them stranded on a bar or shore where they lie, half buried in the sand, until they decay.
cn: 它们的尸体顺流而下，直到洪水退去并将其留在沙洲或岸滩上，它们会被沙子半掩着躺在那里，直至腐烂。
